JOB POSTING

OFFICER, CLASSIFICATION

About the Canadian Paralympic Committee

The Canadian Paralympic Committee is a private, non-profit organization that works in partnership with 28-member sport organizations to advance the Paralympic movement in Canada and support high-performance athletes with disabilities.

Through the stories, achievements, and leadership of Paralympians, the Canadian Paralympic Committee aim to inspire Canadians to embrace accessibility, challenge perceptions, and create greater opportunities for participation in sport and in society.

Job Summary

The Classification Officer plays a vital role in strengthening the Paralympic System in Canada. Their main objective is to provide classification expertise, guidance, and education to National Sport Organizations (NSO), athletes, and other partners in the Canadian sport system. They will also link closely with teams within the CPC to provide support on any classification-related topics.

The ideal candidate will have experience as a classifier and a clear understanding of classification and the associated codes, policies, and processes. Experience as a Para athlete or Paralympian is considered an asset for this position.

Type: Full-Time

Salary: $60,000-$68,000 annually based on experience plus benefits

Reports To: Senior Manager, Paralympic System and Services

Location: Remote within Canada, with travel to Ottawa and other locations

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Supports the implementation of programming that aligns with the CPC’s strategic priorities.
  • Provides guidance, support, and education to enhance the capacity and capability of athletes, stakeholders, members and performance partners in topics related to classification.
  • Supports the development of training and resources to address classification gaps identified through surveys and specific strategies such as the Paralympic Summer Sport System Strategy.
  • Works closely with NSOs to ensure that athletes have the required classifications completed, guides them through the process, and supports them with any issues that arise.
  • Works with the Paralympic performance team, Performance Sciences, Research and Innovation (PSRI) Advisor, Athlete Services team and performance partners (Own The Podium, Sport Canada, Coaching Association of Canada, etc.) to identify gaps related to classification and collaborate in finding evidence-based solutions.
  • Liaises with Athlete Services team to ensure classification services and programming provide an athlete-centric approach while driving best-prepared teams.
  • Contributes to and implements multi-year classification plans, targets, and budgets.
  • Develops rapport, establishes partnerships, and manages relationships with international stakeholders including, but not limited to, International Federations, National Paralympic Committees, officials and volunteers, advisory groups, and IPC departments.

National Priorities

  • Lead Canada’s compliance with the IPC Classification Code
  • Lead Canada’s involvement in any future reviews of the IPC Athlete Classification Code and related documents
  • Lead CPC’s National classification strategy, update where required and prioritize the implementation of recommendations. Examples of priority areas include:
    • Support development of a classification medical expert network to support NSOs and staff on classification needs
    • Support development and implementation of a Visual Impairment (VI) Classification plan for a centrally managed VI Classification system
    • Work with and support NSOs to provide tools and resources to develop national sport-specific strategies that are aligned with International Federations (IFs) and the International Paralympic Committee (IPC)
    • Support the development, refinement, and continuous improvement of Paralympic system classification tools
    • Develop a classification webpage and education materials to support different audiences

International Priorities

  • Engage with IPC and IFs to support classification protocols and processes when appropriate
  • Engage with IPC and other NPCs to support the review and implementation of the Classification Code
  • Work with NSOs and their IFs to host international classifier training in Canada as required
  • Work with NSOs and IFs to support athletes’ classification internationally as required
  • Maintain effective relationships with other NPCs to share best practices, identify opportunities for collaboration, and identify priority areas aligned with international opportunities.

At Games Priorities

  • Coordinate and support the planning and delivery of a Games-specific classification strategy aligned with the NSOs’ plans
  • Provide input and advice on classification management at Games when classification is offered, in addition to providing support for emerging issues

Qualifications

Education

  • Post-secondary education, preferably in kinesiology or sport management, or equivalent experience in a similar position with a sport organization or as an athlete or a coach.

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience working in a leadership capacity in sport in Canada.
  • Experience working in a National Sport Organization.
  • Experience working in multi-sport Games environments.
  • Experience as a Paralympian is considered an asset.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong sport technical knowledge including an understanding of the Canadian Sport system, the International Olympic and Paralympic Sport System, and the roles, responsibilities, and pressures of athletes, coaches, and NSOs.
  • Strong understanding of classification
  • Strong understanding of the IPC, other National Paralympic Committees, and other countries’ sport systems.
  • Strong understanding of the Games environment to best prepare team members to perform during the Paralympic Games and Parapan Am Games.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex environments and solve problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan, coordinate, deliver, and review targeted initiatives as well as adapt to a changing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage relationships and work effectively and collaboratively with both internal and external colleagues.
  • Proficiency with office applications such as email, project planning, databases, word processing, spreadsheets, presentation development, etc.
  • Ability to communicate in Canada’s two official languages is considered a strong asset.

Personal Characteristics

  • Methodical and organized, able to manage different projects at the same time
  • Ability to adapt to a variety of situations, people, environments, and diverse stakeholders
  • Self-directed and disciplined
  • Innovative
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Analytical
  • Results-oriented
  • Team player
  • Cooperative and collaborative
  • Detail-oriented with a thorough approach to problem-solving and work processes

Working Conditions

· The CPC will consider applicants from across Canada who are interested in taking on this position remotely. The CPC Head Office is located in Ottawa, ON.

· This position requires overnight travel to sites within Canada (e.g., Games, events, partner meetings, etc.).

· Staff based outside Ottawa will be expected to travel to Ottawa a few times a year or as the job demands.

· Staff will be required to work evenings and weekends during busy periods, including during Games time and other special events.

Application Process:

If you share our passion for sport and are committed to the CPC values, please submit a cover letter and your résumé.

Please apply through BambooHR using the following link:

Application deadline: October 14th, 2026, at 5 PM EST

Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

CPC conducts all recruitment and selection activities in-house and does not utilize external recruitment agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters as part of its hiring process. All communications regarding employment opportunities and hiring decisions will come directly from authorized CPC employees. We encourage candidates to exercise caution and verify the legitimacy of any employment-related communications.

CPC is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, record of offences, age, marital status, family status, or disability. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented or marginalized groups to apply.

CPC welcomes and encourages applications from First Nations, Métis, and Inuit peoples, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, women, and/or 2SLGBTQ+ individuals. Accommodation is available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

At Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH), we know our future success depends on our ability to attract and retain the very best talent. As you learn more about our company, we think you will agree that there is no better time than now to become a member of the NCLH family!

  • Establishes and maintains quality customer relationships by delivering exceptional customer service, establishing rapport, identifying and meeting customer needs and expectations to include meeting customer retention goals and following up with consumers as necessary, in order to close sale and meet/exceed revenue goals.

Job Description:

At Cable One and our family of brands, we keep our customers and associates connected to what matters most. For our associates, that means: a thriving and rewarding career, respect for the communities where they live and work, a focus on health and wellness, an excellent work/life balance, and an open and inclusive workplace.  

We’re looking to add to our already amazing team of associates. If you’d like to join an organization that is dedicated to customer and associate satisfaction, check out this exciting sales opportunity.

Cable One’s Retention Business Account Representatives are responsible for developing, renewing contracts, and maintaining a base of existing business customers who subscribe to our voice and broadband services. As a Representative, you will speak to small and medium-sized companies who call in to disconnect their services. Your goal will be to show them the value that Cable One can bring to their company by showing them services that may better fit their needs or troubleshoot to resolve their current concerns.

What you will do to contribute to the company's success 

  • Use a variety of problem-solving techniques to retain customers who call to reduce or cancel their services. 

  • Connect with our current customers and help them renew their contracts. 

  • Follow up with subscribers to answer their questions or confirm if we can help answer their questions. 

  • Identify reasons for customer dissatisfaction with product and provide prompt resolution in order to retain the customer.

  • Up-sells Sparklight products that include digital, HSD, and phone to existing business customers.

  • Team up with other departments here at Sparklight to help answer customer questions or resolve their concerns. 

  • This position has the expectation and responsibility to take on other duties needed to help drive our Purpose, fulfill our Brand Principles, and abide by our Organization's Values.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or three to six months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Associate’s degree (A.A.) preferred.

  • We prefer for you to have experience in telecommunications, but we are happy to teach you! 

  • Prior sales experience preferred.

  • Requires the ability to work independently and in a team environment.

  • Must be detailed oriented and self-starter.

  • You will be working with customers who may be frustrated, we are looking for candidates who can keep calm and be patient in all situations. 

  • Confidence to be persistent and professionally sell our services after a customer declines on an offer. 

  • Problem-solving is key! Sometimes you will need to look for creative routes to get the customer to say 'yes' to a sale!

Core Competencies  

  • Committed: Values each and every customer, while working hard to keep their business and support our communities.  

  • Helpful: Delivers support in the ways that are most useful to our customers and addresses their needs with expertise, respect, and empathy.  

  • Proactive: Understand what our customers need, and actively works to make their relationship with use seamless, easy, and rewarding.  

  • Personal: Knows our customers well, and tailors our communications and interactions to address their needs and expectations.  

​

Benefits 

Cable One and our family of brands appreciates the role our associates play to help the company grow, and in return an excellent benefits package is offered to our associates to recognize the importance of their contributions, such as:  

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans – start when you start!  

  • Life insurance (self, spouse, children) 

  • Paid time off (vacation, holiday, and personal/sick days)  

  • 401(k) - 100% company match (match program starts after 1 year of service, up to 5% of eligible compensation) 

  • Group Legal plan with Identity Theft Protection 

Additional Perks  

  • Tuition reimbursement (up to $5,250 on 1st year)  

  • Up to seventy-five dollars a month towards cable and internet services  

  • Annual community support to various organizations across the U.S.  

  • Associate recognition & awards programs 

  • Advancement opportunities  

  • Collaborative work environment  

Our Commitment 

Diversity lies in the communities we serve and among the associates who dedicate themselves to ensure our continued success. Here at Cable One and our family of brands, we believe it is our individual and unique talents, backgrounds and perspectives that, when combined, truly make us an unstoppable force. "Stronger Together" is not just a verbal cue, it is the motto that our associates live by, exemplify, and embody each and every day.  

Cable One and our family of brands is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability. 

 

Pre-hire Processes 

Cable One and our family of brands is committed to keeping our associates and customers safe. Job offers are contingent upon the results of background, drug screening, and reference check. Only after successfully passing these pre-hire clearances are individuals approved for hire and ready to start their successful and rewarding career.

Job Location: Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

IQVIA Discovery Sciences


Location: Flexible Global


Leading the future of technology assisted drug discovery


IQVIA Discovery Sciences is seeking an exceptional Chief Scientist, Modern Drug Discovery to shape and deliver our scientific vision for the next generation of drug discovery services.


This is a high-impact leadership role for a recognised discovery expert who can combine scientific excellence in drug discovery with a passion for AI-enabled innovation, computational science, automation, and translational biology. Working alongside a highly accomplished scientific leadership team, you will help define the talent, capabilities, technologies, and partnerships that will keep IQVIA at the forefront of modern drug discovery.



What You'll Do


Define and execute a forward-looking scientific strategy aligned to evolving client and industry needs.

Drive the adoption of AI-assisted design, predictive modelling, automation, computational sciences, and translational approaches.

Provide scientific leadership across a diverse discovery portfolio, ensuring excellence, rigour, and translational relevance.

Support strategic client engagements, proposals, partnerships, and business growth opportunities.

Act as a senior scientific ambassador with clients, collaborators, and industry stakeholders.

Mentor and inspire multidisciplinary teams across biology, chemistry, protein design, pharmacology, translational, and computational sciences.



About You


PhD or DPhil in a relevant life sciences discipline.

Significant senior leadership experience (10 years+ in leadership roles) within pharmaceutical or, biotechnology industry., Experience of CRO environments is an advantage but not essential.

Proven success advancing discovery programmes from concept through to clinic.

Strong expertise in translational biology and pharmacology with strong track record in at least one major therapeutic modality.

Experience applying AI, computational approaches, and data-driven decision-making within discovery settings.

A collaborative leader who combines scientific credibility with commercial awareness and client focus.



Why IQVIA Discovery Sciences?


Drug discovery is entering a transformative era. This is a unique opportunity to shape how medicines are discovered by combining scientific excellence with emerging technologies and translational innovation in a scaled clinical and data centric setting..


You'll work alongside an outstanding scientific leadership team, collaborate with leading biopharma organisations, and help define the future of discovery services across IQVIA's network.



If you're a visionary scientific leader ready to influence the future of drug discovery, we'd love to hear from you.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

raw.description:
About Delfina

Every pregnancy deserves to be seen, supported, and safe. Delfina is a maternal health technology company using AI-powered platform to support pregnant and postpartum patients. We partner with health plans, community health centers, health systems, and public sector agencies to close gaps in care before they become emergencies.

Our model is built on outcomes: we increasingly work through value-based arrangements with Medicaid and commercial health plans. That makes financial rigor central to our mission, not separate from it.

The role

We're looking for a Fractional CFO to own Delfina's financial strategy as we scale and prepare for our next phase of growth. You'll be a hands-on partner to our CEO, a trusted voice with our board and investors, and the person who translates our impact into a durable financial model.

This is a great fit for a finance leader who has done this before at an early-stage digital health company and wants their next chapter to matter for families.

What you'll do

  • Lead fundraising and investor relations: build the financial model, data room, and diligence responses; partner with the CEO on pitch and investor conversations
  • Own planning and reporting: annual budget, rolling forecasts, cash runway, and monthly board-ready reporting
  • Build the finance function: oversee accounting, close, audit readiness, tax, and outside providers (bookkeeping, payroll, legal)
  • Strengthen unit economics: cost-to-serve, gross margin, and contract profitability by partner and program
  • Manage risk and compliance: controls, grant and public-contract financial requirements, insurance, and vendor contracts
  • Shape payer contract economics: model pricing, value-based/risk arrangements with health plans and public partners
  • Advise the leadership team: bring financial clarity to hiring, pricing, and market expansion decisions

What you bring

  • CFO or VP Finance experience at one or more Seed–Series C digital health companies
  • Hands-on experience with payers and health plans — ideally Medicaid managed care, value-based contracts, or risk arrangements
  • A track record of supporting a successful priced equity round (Series A or later)
  • Board-level presence — you've presented to boards and investors and managed demanding stakeholders with clarity and calm
  • Comfort being both strategic and in depth in financial data — at our stage, there's no team to delegate to yet
  • Genuine commitment to health equity and to improving outcomes for women and families

Nice to have

  • Experience with public sector, grant, or government contract finance
  • Background in maternal, women's, or population health
  • Familiarity with FQHC or community health center economics
  • Prior experience as a fractional or part-time CFO across multiple companies

What we offer

  • Compensation: Monthly retainer or hourly rate options, equity eligibility if applicable
  • Flexible, remote-first engagement with a mission-driven team
  • Potential path to a full-time role as Delfina grows

We value that everyone at Delfina brings a unique background and perspective. Prospective applicants are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet 100% of the listed qualifications and are encouraged to use their resume and other application materials to demonstrate how their skills meet, or are equivalent to, the listed qualifications.

Delfina provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or family status, national origin, age, veteran or disability status.

Note that Delfina does not currently sponsor or facilitate any U.S. work authorization for this position. All applicants must have unrestricted and independent authorization to work at Delfina. Delfina participates in the E-verify program to confirm employment authorization eligibility.

Mehr Freiheit. Mehr Verantwortung. Mehr aus Ihrem Kundenstamm machen.

Sie sind Finanzberater und möchten nicht länger in starren Vertriebsstrukturen, mit Produktvorgaben und klassischen KPI-Zielen arbeiten?

Dann könnte dieses Modell zu Ihnen passen.

Unser Mandant ist ein etabliertes Beraternetzwerk mit über 15 Jahren Markterfahrung und einem bundesweiten Netzwerk aus selbstständigen Beratern und spezialisierten Experten.

Die Idee: Sie bauen Ihr eigenes Beratungsgeschäft auf – mit maximaler unternehmerischer Freiheit und einer professionellen Infrastruktur im Hintergrund.

Sie entscheiden, worauf Sie sich spezialisieren, welche Kunden Sie beraten und wie Sie Ihr Geschäft entwickeln. Für Themen außerhalb Ihrer Kernkompetenz können Sie auf Spezialisten aus dem Netzwerk zurückgreifen.

Aufgaben

  • Beratung von Privat- und Geschäftskunden in Ihren persönlichen Schwerpunkten – z. B. Investment, Versicherung oder Finanzierung
  • Aufbau und Entwicklung eines eigenen Kundenstamms
  • Analyse individueller Kundenbedarfe und Entwicklung passender Finanzstrategien
  • Einbindung von Spezialisten, wenn zusätzliche Expertise gefragt ist
  • Ausbau Ihrer persönlichen Positionierung und Beratungsstruktur
  • Entwicklung Ihres Geschäfts mit dem Ziel, nachhaltige und übertragbare Erträge aufzubauen

Ihr Kundenstamm ist ein zentraler Bestandteil Ihres Geschäfts.

  • Kundenbeziehungen verbleiben bei Ihnen
  • Aufbau eines übertragbaren Bestands
  • Möglichkeit zur späteren Übergabe oder Veräußerung
  • Entwicklung eines langfristig werthaltigen Geschäftsmodells

Professionelle Infrastruktur statt unnötiger Administration

Sie konzentrieren sich auf Ihre Kunden – die Plattform unterstützt Sie im Hintergrund.

Dazu gehören unter anderem:

  • Professionelle Investmentlösungen über ein reguliertes Haftungsdach
  • Rechtliche und administrative Unterstützung
  • Marketing- und Positionierungsunterstützung
  • Zugang zu spezialisierten Netzwerkpartnern
  • Austausch und Kooperation innerhalb eines bundesweiten Beraternetzwerks

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in der Finanzberatung, z. B. aus Bank, Versicherung oder Finanzdienstleistung
  • Freude an Beratung und Kundenkontakt
  • Vertriebsstärke und unternehmerisches Denken
  • Eigenverantwortliche und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Bereitschaft, einen eigenen Kundenstamm und eine langfristige Beratungsstruktur aufzubauen
  • Idealerweise bestehende Kundenkontakte oder einen eigenen Bestand

Benefits

Unternehmerisch frei

  • Selbstständige Tätigkeit mit hoher Entscheidungsfreiheit
  • Keine Produktvorgaben
  • Keine klassischen Vertriebsvorgaben oder KPI-Strukturen
  • Freie Spezialisierung auf Ihre fachlichen und vertrieblichen Stärken

Ganzheitlich beraten – ohne alles selbst machen zu müssen

Sie müssen nicht in jedem Finanzthema Experte sein.

Konzentrieren Sie sich auf Ihre Kernkompetenzen und greifen Sie bei Bedarf auf ein bundesweites Netzwerk spezialisierter Berater zurück.

So können Kunden ganzheitlich in den Bereichen Investment, Versicherung und Finanzierung betreut werden, ohne dass Sie jedes Thema selbst abdecken müssen.

  • Attraktives, leistungsorientiertes Vergütungsmodell
  • Laufende Bestandsprovisionen
  • Aufbau wiederkehrender Einnahmen
  • Steigerung der Wertschöpfung pro Kunde durch Spezialisierung und Arbeitsteilung

Für wen ist das interessant?

Für Finanzberater, die sagen:

„Ich möchte mein eigenes Geschäft aufbauen – aber nicht alles alleine organisieren müssen.“

Wenn Sie Ihre fachlichen Stärken stärker nutzen, unabhängiger arbeiten und sich langfristig einen eigenen, übertragbaren Kundenbestand aufbauen möchten, bietet dieses Modell dafür die entsprechende Plattform.

Lassen Sie uns unverbindlich darüber sprechen, wie das Modell konkret funktioniert und welche Möglichkeiten sich für Ihre aktuelle Situation ergeben.

Diskret. Unverbindlich. Auf Augenhöhe.

About the Job

The Opportunity

As a Product Marketing Manager at JivPad, you will be instrumental in shaping how the world discovers and experiences a new era of human communication. JivPad is redefining accessibility and connection through AI-powered voice technology, enabling individuals with speech or hearing differences, and anyone who desires intelligent call assistance, to communicate with confidence, clarity, and authenticity. Our platform also delivers real-time translation for in-person conversations, breaking language barriers effortlessly.

In this role, you will craft the narrative that introduces JivPad to the world. You will collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Growth teams to develop and execute go-to-market strategies that drive adoption, deepen user engagement, and establish JivPad as the definitive platform for intelligent communication. You will serve as the voice of our audience, translating their needs into compelling positioning, messaging, and campaigns that resonate across markets.

This is a unique opportunity to join a founding-stage team at the moment of launch, where your work will directly shape brand perception and market trajectory. The pace is intentional, the standards are high, and the impact is immediate.

What You'll Do

Develop and own JivPad's product positioning, messaging frameworks, and go-to-market strategy across all channels and audiences. Create premium marketing collateral, product narratives, launch campaigns, and sales enablement materials that reflect our commitment to excellence. Partner with Product and Engineering to translate complex AI and voice technology into clear, emotionally resonant stories that connect with diverse user segments. Identify and cultivate strategic growth opportunities by analysing market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging accessibility and communication technology markets. Collaborate with PR, content, partnerships, and community teams to drive awareness, demand, and long-term brand equity. Champion the voice of our users, particularly those in the accessibility community, ensuring their stories and needs are at the centre of everything we bring to market. Build and nurture relationships with advocates, partners, and key stakeholders to foster enduring loyalty and business growth.

What You'll Need to Succeed

A degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related discipline, with 2+ years of experience in product marketing, brand strategy, or growth marketing within a technology or SaaS organisation. A portfolio or demonstrated history of crafting compelling go-to-market strategies and premium brand narratives. Experience thriving in fast-paced, early-stage environments where ambiguity is an invitation and ownership is expected. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a refined eye for detail and an instinct for storytelling that moves people. A deeply collaborative disposition, with the ability to work cross-functionally across Product, Design, Engineering, and Growth to deliver unified, high-impact initiatives. Genuine passion for accessibility, inclusive technology, or communication innovation is highly valued.

Role Details

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Founding team, pre-launch

About JivPad

JivPad is a modern communication platform built on the belief that everyone deserves to be heard, understood, and in control of their own voice. Our AI-powered calling technology enables users to make phone calls with full autonomy, whether they choose to speak through AI using their own cloned voice, direct the conversation in real time via text, or seamlessly take over the call themselves. Our live translation feature allows people speaking different languages to converse naturally, in person, without delays or interruptions.

We are not building another AI calling tool. We are building the future of human connection, where technology amplifies who you are rather than replacing you.

Equal Opportunity

JivPad is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin.

If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care.

Let's build the future of communication, together.

THE PROJECT 📝

We're looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Security Engineer to join Form3 on a 12 month fixed term contract basis to deliver a strategic programme of security enhancements across our cloud-native payments platform.

Focusing on improving cloud security, operational resilience and governance across our engineering ecosystem, you will work closely with our Platform Engineering and Security teams to design and implement practical security improvements that enhance how we build, deploy and operate critical payment infrastructure.

You'll play a key role in strengthening areas such as cloud platform security, software supply chain security, identity and access management, AI governance, cryptographic controls and automated security assurance, ensuring solutions are scalable, production-ready and aligned with regulatory expectations.

Key responsibilities

  • Assess the current cloud security posture across Form3 environments, identifying risks, control gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Design and implement scalable cloud security controls that improve the resilience and security of our cloud-native platform.
  • Enhance perimeter security controls across cloud infrastructure.
  • Strengthen CI/CD pipeline security through secure build processes, automated security testing, deployment governance and artefact integrity.
  • Improve production access security, including RBAC, least-privilege implementation, deployment tooling and operational processes.
  • Enhance software supply chain security through dependency management, container image scanning, provenance, signing and vulnerability remediation.
  • Contribute to the secure adoption and governance of AI-enabled engineering capabilities, including controls for data protection, auditability and operational resilience.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on cloud security architecture and secure engineering practices.
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, including solution designs, implementation plans, operational procedures and security evidence.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, platform and security teams to deliver maintainable, production-ready security improvements.
  • Ensure all deliverables align with operational resilience requirements, regulatory obligations and internal security standards.
  • Deliver changes using structured, low-risk change management practices while maintaining service availability.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍

Essential

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing cloud security solutions within large-scale cloud-native environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience securing public cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
  • Expertise in cloud security architecture, identity and access management, workload protection and infrastructure security.
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
  • Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including dependency management, artefact signing, provenance and vulnerability management.
  • Experience implementing least-privilege access models and RBAC.
  • Knowledge of security monitoring, risk assessment and security governance.
  • Experience working within highly regulated or business-critical production environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams.
  • Strong technical documentation and design skills.

Desirable

  • Experience implementing security controls for AI or machine learning platforms.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic controls and key management.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and policy-as-code tooling.
  • Familiarity with payment platforms or financial services environments.
  • Understanding of operational resilience frameworks and regulatory requirements affecting critical financial infrastructure.
  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP or similar).

TECH STACK ⚙️

  • AWS – Cloud infrastructure and security controls.
  • Kubernetes – Container orchestration and workload security.
  • Terraform – Infrastructure as Code and security automation.
  • CI/CD tooling – Secure software delivery, build security and deployment governance.
  • Container security tooling – Image scanning, vulnerability management and runtime protection.
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) – Least privilege, RBAC and privileged access controls.
  • Software Supply Chain Security – Dependency scanning, artefact signing, provenance and integrity controls.
  • Security monitoring & observability platforms – Detection, auditability and operational visibility.
  • AI governance and security controls – Supporting secure adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities.

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️

Stage 1: Screening Call with Talent Team

Stage 2: Cloud Security & Engineering Best Practices interview

Stage 3 (optional): Team interview

We always aim to stick to the above process, however there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is needed for us to be sure we’re hiring the right fit for the role.

  • UK

All new team members start their first day in our office to collect the equipment needed to work remotely.

ABOUT FORM3 💭

Revolutionising the world of payments with our cloud-native, multi-cloud platform. For more information about Form3, check out the following pages:

What we do | Life at Form3 | Payments Cannot Fail Series | .Tech Podcast

raw.description:
Bilingual Patient Navigator (Clinical Trials) – English/ Japanese Location: USA (Remote)
Employment Type: W2 Flexible Contract
Qualification Requirements: Nurse or Registered Dietitians (RD) or Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDN)

Commitment: Part-time (0.1* FTE initially) with potential for growth
Are you a clinical research professional who loves the freedom and autonomy of a contractor lifestyle, but values the stability of a W2 setup? If you enjoy diving into diverse clinical projects, setting your own pace, and acting as a vital bridge between patients and cutting-edge medical research, this is the perfect opportunity for you.
We are seeking a highly skilled, tech-savvy, and empathetic Bilingual Patient Navigator (PN) based in the USA. This is a highly flexible, part-time contract role starting at 0.1 FTE*, making it an ideal fit to balance alongside other freelance projects or personal commitments. As our study pipeline evolves, there is open potential for this workload to change and expand.
What You’ll Do As a Patient Navigator, you will support diverse participants and their caregivers through their clinical trial journey, ensuring they feel valued, informed, and supported. Your core responsibilities will span across two critical service areas:
  • Participant Support & Retention: Manage a live inbound/outbound call environment. You will build trusting relationships with participants, field protocol questions, manage study logistics, and offer essential emotional support in both English and Japanese.
  • Digital Campaign Prescreening: Conduct outbound telephone calls to pre-qualified digital leads within 1–2 business days. Using IRB/EC-approved scripts, you will determine initial eligibility, handle site referrals, and follow up to reduce site burden.
Key Responsibilities
  • Bilingual Support: Confidently conduct participant outreach, answer inbound queries, and deliver empathetic support in both English and Japanese.
  • Rapid Query Resolution: Respond efficiently to patient inquiries regarding trial schedules, logistics, and general well-being, while managing multiple digital queries simultaneously.
  • Triage & Escalation: Swiftly recognize queries that require escalation to emergency services, clinical sites, or the HQ project management team.
  • Data & System Management: Utilize a modern helpdesk platform to document interactions, manage tickets, and provide clean summary reports to project managers.
  • Site Collaboration: Build strong, personalized relationships with CRAs and study sites to ensure seamless patient follow-up and tracking.
What We Are Looking ForThis role requires a unique mix of clinical trial expertise, language skills, technical agility, and deep empathy. To be successful, you must bring:
  • Language Skills: Native or professional fluency in both English and Japanese (verbal and written) is required.
  • Experience: A minimum of two (2) years of relevant Clinical Research experience.
  • Certifications: Current GCP certification and a strong working knowledge of HIPAA regulations. (Mental Health First Aid certification is a strong plus).
  • Tech Savviness: High comfort level navigating various communication pathways (web chat, email, phone lines) and helpdesk ticketing software. Proficiency in Google Workspace and MS Office is required.
  • The Contractor Mindset: Self-motivated, highly organized, comfortable with independent remote work, and capable of switching gears quickly between talking to a patient and collaborating with a clinical site.
Work Setup & Logistics
  • Flexibility First: You will always be asked about your availability before being assigned to a specific study or service.
  • Home Office: You must provide your own reliable, excellent home internet connection.
  • Travel: While this is primarily a remote role, if project-related travel to sites or outreach locations is required, full reimbursement is provided in line with company policy.
Ready to Navigate the Future of Clinical Trials?If you are looking for a flexible, patient-centric contract role where you can use your bilingual skills to make a difference at your own cadence, we want to hear from you.

raw.description:
Job Title – Protection & Control (P&C) Field Testing Engineer

Location – 100% Remote (20 Openings) with up to 80% travel

Base Salary – $120,000 – $160,000

JOB# 83413010

Industry: Energy – Utilities

Job Category: Engineering

Employment Type – Full Time

Position Overview:

The Protection & Control (P&C) Field Testing Engineer performs testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and documentation of critical protection systems on high-voltage substations. This travel-intensive role supports transmission, distribution, and generation projects while ensuring compliance with safety and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform testing and commissioning of Protection and Control systems on high-voltage substations
  • Conduct hands-on protective relay testing using Omicron CMC 256 or 356 or Doble F6150
  • Test relays including SEL-311L, SEL-387, SEL-487, SEL-421, SEL-351S, GE L90, GE D60, and similar devices
  • Execute control scheme testing, CT and PT circuit verification, relay calibration, and static and dynamic testing
  • Support Project Leads and Field Supervisors on active projects
  • Complete Job Hazard Analysis and adhere to all safety requirements
  • Read and interpret electrical drawings, schematics, and logic diagrams
  • Accurately record test data and produce formal field reports
  • Manage clerical tasks including timecards, expenses, and project documentation

Qualifications

    Field Experience:
    5+ years of experience in electrical field testing of substations including breakers, transformers, and transformer systems

    Relay Systems Expertise:
    Proficiency with SEL, GE, Basler, and Beckwith relay families

    Testing Equipment Skills:
    Skilled in relay testing using Omicron or Doble test sets

    Standards and Compliance Knowledge:
    Experience with NETA, IEEE, NFPA, and other applicable industry standards

    Voltage Range Exposure:
    Working knowledge of projects ranging from 15 kV to 500 kV

    Software Proficiency:
    Ability to use ProTesT, Protection Suite, ENOSERV RTS, Omicron Test Universe, and AcSELerator

How to Apply

Submit resume, JD transcripts, and clearance to PK Daigo, Managing Director & Global Strategist at KI Executive
or WhatsApp +1-670-286-3010

What We're Looking For

You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to be technically credible, naturally curious, and comfortable going deep when the conversation requires it

What You'll Do and Own

  • Other Duties as Assigned.

We'd Be Especially Interested If

You've worked for a healthcare technology company and have firsthand experience navigating enterprise healthcare sales.

You understand why an EHR integration question can change the trajectory of a deal. You've been through security reviews. You've presented to IT teams and executives in the same sales cycle. You know how to uncover technical requirements without turning discovery into an interrogation.

And when a salesperson says, "I need you on this call," you're the person they want in the room.

Ideally, you bring

  • 3+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

Healthcare SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

  • Experience working with health systems, medical groups, DSOs, hospitals, or other complex healthcare organizations is a significant plus.
  • Strong technical discovery and product demonstration skills.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, data exchange, authentication, SSO, and modern SaaS architecture.

  • US Residents only. Must reside in the continental U.S., be authorized to work without sponsorship, and not reside in California.

Compensation

In addition to the base salary, this role offers performance-based commission opportunities with OTE range of $137,500 to $150,000. Actual total compensation will depend on a candidate’s skills, qualifications, years of relevant experience, and individual performance.

What You’ll Get

  • Smart, intellectually curious, creative, supportive, and overall awesome colleagues!
  • We are 100% fully remote! Work from anywhere in the U.S. with reliable Wi-Fi, within PST–EST time zones. Employees must be physically located in the U.S.; working outside the U.S. requires prior approval from leadership.

About rater8

rater8, the healthcare industry’s leader in reputation management, helps medical practices establish pervasive online visibility. About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing Account Manager to manage relationships and marketing performance for a portfolio of local business clients.

This role combines client account management, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, performance reporting, and AI-assisted execution. You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, helping them understand their results while proactively identifying opportunities, resolving issues, and keeping their accounts moving forward.

The ideal candidate understands both sides of the role: strong client communication and hands-on digital marketing execution.

What You’ll Own

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients
  • Build trust through consistent and proactive communication
  • Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals
  • Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work
  • Track commitments and follow through on client requests
  • Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them
  • Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

Local SEO & Google Business Profile

  • Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles
  • Maintain accurate business information and local listings
  • Support review-management workflows
  • Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance
  • Implement appropriate on-page and off-page SEO tactics for local markets
  • Identify opportunities to improve local organic visibility
  • Monitor performance changes and investigate ranking declines
  • Ensure Local SEO execution aligns with each client’s business objectives

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Monitor performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics
  • Review search visibility, traffic, rankings, and other relevant performance indicators
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues
  • Turn data into clear and actionable recommendations
  • Prepare client-facing performance reports
  • Explain results to non-technical clients in a straightforward way
  • Use reporting to keep clients informed and engaged with their progress

AI-Assisted Marketing Execution

  • Use Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate day-to-day marketing workflows
  • Draft client-facing and marketing content with AI assistance
  • Conduct research and streamline recurring deliverables
  • Review, edit, and quality-check AI-generated work before delivery
  • Adapt outputs to each client’s brand, context, and objectives
  • Apply independent judgment rather than relying on AI-generated output without review

Issue Resolution & Account Ownership

  • Identify performance dips or account concerns early
  • Diagnose potential causes using available SEO and analytics data
  • Coordinate internally to resolve client issues
  • Communicate clearly with clients when problems arise
  • Track issues through resolution
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned accounts

Growth & Upsell Opportunities

  • Identify opportunities where additional marketing services could meaningfully benefit clients
  • Recognize when services such as Google Ads may complement existing Local SEO efforts
  • Communicate recommendations clearly and consultatively
  • Focus on genuine client value rather than aggressive selling
  • Coordinate internally when additional services are appropriate

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role
  • Experience working with local businesses or SMB clients preferred
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles
  • Experience with review management and local listing accuracy
  • Working proficiency with Google Search Console
  • Working proficiency with Google Analytics
  • Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients
  • Professional experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude
  • Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated content
  • Excellent client communication and relationship-management skills
  • Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities
  • Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts
  • Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team
  • Availability to work full-time U.S. Mountain Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Google Ads
  • Local SEO agency experience
  • Experience managing multiple SMB or local-business accounts simultaneously
  • Familiarity with local search ranking factors and optimization workflows
  • Experience diagnosing organic search performance issues
  • Experience identifying cross-sell or upsell opportunities
  • Strong understanding of AI-assisted marketing workflows

Tools & Platforms

Google Business Profile | Google Search Console | Google Analytics | ChatGPT | Claude | Local SEO Tools | Google Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Communicate proactively so clients don’t need to chase you for updates
  • Take ownership of accounts from start to finish
  • Understand Local SEO beyond simply updating a Google Business Profile
  • Can look at Search Console or Analytics data and identify what actually matters
  • Explain technical marketing information clearly to business owners
  • Flag performance issues early and take action
  • Use AI as a productivity tool without sacrificing judgment or quality
  • Know when AI-generated content needs significant rewriting
  • Are organized enough to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deliverables
  • Can work independently while staying aligned with a remote team
  • Look for growth opportunities based on genuine client needs rather than pushing unnecessary services

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day will operate on U.S. Mountain Time and balance proactive client management with hands-on marketing execution.

You may start by reviewing overnight client messages and identifying anything requiring immediate attention. From there, you could optimize Google Business Profiles, review Search Console for ranking changes or crawl issues, and analyze Google Analytics data for upcoming client reports.

You may use Claude or ChatGPT to accelerate content, research, or recommendations before applying your own judgment and editing the final output. Afternoons may include client check-ins or internal meetings to align on priorities and resolve outstanding issues.

In short: you’ll own client relationships while ensuring their Local SEO work is executed, measured, communicated, and continuously improved.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Client retention and satisfaction
  • Quality and consistency of client communication
  • Google Business Profile optimization and accuracy
  • Local search visibility and performance
  • Organic traffic and search trends
  • Accuracy and usefulness of client reporting
  • Timeliness of deliverables and follow-ups

Architect

Contract Architect | Fabric Platform Engineering Hands-on architecture role across reusable platform products, APIs, datastores, UX, cloud and AI-enabled engineering

Role summary

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on contract architect to support our Fabric platform engineering team. The role combines architecture leadership with practical delivery: shaping product direction, creating architecture blueprints, guiding engineering teams, reviewing code and, where useful, writing code or prototypes directly. The architect will work across platform products and reusable services as priorities evolve, with a strong focus on pragmatic delivery, secure design and engineering quality.

What you will do

  • Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts and stakeholders to clarify outcomes, shape product vision and translate requirements into pragmatic architecture options.
  • Produce concise architecture blueprints, high-level and low-level designs, technical decision records and implementation guidance for platform products.
  • Design secure, scalable and reusable services, APIs, datastore patterns, integration approaches, UX-facing capabilities and common components.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to turn architecture into implementation, including hands-on prototyping, code review, pair design, design assurance and technical debt management.
  • Select appropriate technologies, promote reuse, define development standards and help create common frameworks or accelerators across the platform.
  • Participate in planning and estimation, maintain the architecture backlog and make trade-offs across cost, risk, quality, security and time-to-market.
  • Coordinate with other architects, security, platform and engineering teams to align designs with enterprise standards and delivery constraints.
  • Apply AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices responsibly to improve delivery, quality, documentation, testing and developer productivity.

Required skills and experience

  • Strong architecture experience across cloud-native application, integration, data and security domains, with the judgement to balance governance and delivery pace.
  • Hands-on software engineering capability in at least one modern language such as C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, plus confidence reading and reviewing production code.
  • Practical experience using agentic AI coding tools and AI-assisted delivery workflows, for example GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex-style agents or similar tools.
  • Practical Azure experience, including compute, storage, networking, security, Azure Policy, Entra ID, RBAC, Key Vault and tenant-aware identity patterns.
  • Experience with APIs, microservices, containers and Kubernetes, preferably AKS, plus CI/CD and DevSecOps practices using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.
  • Ability to design access management, authentication and authorisation patterns for users, services and platform-to-platform integrations.
  • Good understanding of compliance, in-application security, secure-by-design patterns and operating within enterprise technology standards.
  • Experience designing for reusability, maintainability, observability, cost optimisation and technical debt control.
  • Clear communication style, able to work with senior stakeholders, product teams, engineers and architects across distributed teams.

Desirable skills

  • Experience with internal developer platforms, reusable engineering assets or platform marketplace models.
  • Experience with generative AI solution patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt evaluation, automated testing and AI governance guardrails.
  • Familiarity with enterprise UX patterns, workflow automation and low-code/no-code product capabilities.
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, TOGAF, SAFe or comparable architecture/security certification.

What good looks like

  • Comfortable moving from strategy to code: can explain the architecture in a stakeholder meeting, then work with engineers on implementation details afterwards.
  • Pragmatic rather than theoretical: makes sensible trade-offs, documents decisions clearly and keeps teams unblocked.
  • Reuse-minded: looks for common patterns and components that can help multiple Fabric products, not just the immediate delivery need.
  • Fluent in AI-enabled engineering, but grounded in security, reliability, maintainability and enterprise delivery standards.

Role type: Contract | Level: Architect / Senior Architect | Team: Fabric Platform Engineering

Wanna join the adventure?
We’re looking for a Technical Sourcer with a strong background in hardware and engineering talent identification to support Loft Orbital’s growing hiring needs on a six-month contract, with the possibility of extension. In this remote role, you’ll focus on proactively identifying, engaging, and building pipelines of highly specialized engineering talent for some of our most challenging positions. You’ll work closely with our recruiters and hiring managers to develop targeted sourcing strategies, map competitive talent markets, and connect with exceptional passive candidates across hardware engineering disciplines.

Must Haves:

  • 3+ years of technical sourcing or recruiting experience, with a strong focus on hardware and engineering talent.
  • Demonstrated expertise in proactive headhunting, including LinkedIn Recruiter, advanced Boolean search, talent mapping, and creative sourcing techniques to identify hard-to-find candidates.
  • Experience sourcing technical talent across hardware engineering disciplines, including mechanical engineering, electrical/electronics, embedded systems, firmware, RF/wireless, systems engineering, and hardware test.
  • Strong understanding of hardware engineering concepts and terminology, including CAD, PCB design, embedded systems, microcontrollers, FPGA, RF systems, and hardware verification and validation.
  • Proven ability to identify and engage passive candidates for niche, highly specialized engineering positions.
  • Experience conducting initial candidate outreach, generating interest, and evaluating basic technical alignment before handing candidates over to recruiters.
  • Ability to independently develop sourcing strategies, identify target companies, and build talent pipelines for multiple technical requisitions.
  • Strong research and market-mapping skills, with the ability to identify relevant companies, emerging talent pools, and competitive hiring markets.
  • Ability to effectively pitch Loft’s mission, culture, and technical challenges to highly specialized, passive candidates.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple sourcing priorities while maintaining accurate candidate records and pipeline activity.
  • Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS tools (Lever preferred), including maintaining accurate sourcing pipelines and tracking outreach activity.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work closely with recruiters and hiring managers, providing sourcing insights, market intelligence, and candidate recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Haves:

    • Direct experience sourcing talent within the space, satellite, aerospace, defense, or adjacent complex hardware/deep-tech industries.
    • Experience sourcing for specialized profiles such as avionics, GNC, RF engineering, PCB/board design, manufacturing engineering, or assembly, integration, and test (AI&T).
    • Prior experience as a dedicated technical sourcer, research specialist, or sourcing partner within an in-house recruiting team or agency.
    • Experience supporting high-volume sourcing initiatives or rapid engineering team expansion.
    • Knowledge of US and European aerospace and hardware engineering talent ecosystems, including key companies, startups, and talent hubs.
    • Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, and compliance considerations relevant to US-based space and defense hiring.
    • Experience using sourcing analytics to track outreach effectiveness, candidate engagement, and pipeline conversion.
    • Prior experience supporting startup or high-growth technical organizations.
*Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple.
Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission to get therapy into the hands of everyone!

We’re looking for a part-time, contract Therapist (Independent Contract Provider) who is passionate about reaching individuals who need mental healthcare but lack easy access to it. This role is perfect for those seeking the opportunity to work with a diverse client base while enjoying the flexibility and rewards of private practice—without the hassle of administrative work. Let Talkspace handle the insurance billing, marketing, and administrative costs, so you can create your own schedule and focus fully on providing impactful care!

What you'll do:

  • Treat clients remotely in your state(s) of licensure on the secure (HIPAA compliant) Talkspace platform
  • Conduct client sessions using video, audio, and live messaging services
  • Respond to asynchronous client messages each week, in a timely manner
  • Complete your required clinical documentation after each client session

About you

  • Current license to practice independently without supervision in Washington, D.C.
    • Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW)
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
    • Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)
  • Individual professional malpractice liability insurance policy
  • Individual NPI number
  • Comfortable learning new online tools and technology
  • Reliable internet connection and video-capable device

Perks

  • Clients Ready for You: Talkspace provides new client referrals
  • Flexible Schedule: Set your own schedule with no minimum requirement for your weekly hours or caseload size
  • No Membership Fees: No provider fees
  • Accept Insurance Without Hassle: Talkspace will take care of all aspects of client insurance including credentialing, billing, and claims
  • Everything in One Place: Sessions, clinical documentation, resources, and compensation tracking on one platform
  • Fully Paid Training: Master the Talkspace platform before your first session
  • Clinical Support: Provider Support and IT teams available for any technical or platform related questions
  • Free CEUs: NBCC and ASWB accredited continuing education credits via Talkspace-provided Learning Communities
  • Health Perks: Access Stride Health to support your health and financial well-being

Compensation

  • $78 per hour for live chat, audio, or video sessions (this rate is prorated for 45 and 30 minute sessions)
  • Additional compensation for asynchronous messaging
  • Earn a new client engagement bonus, varying by plan type

Please note: If you treat clients in multiple states, different rates will apply accordingly. Rates could be subject to change and may vary over time based on the market and shifts in demand.

Why Talkspace

Talkspace is a leading virtual behavioral healthcare provider committed to helping people lead healthier, happier lives through access to high-quality mental healthcare. At Talkspace, we believe that mental healthcare is core to overall health and should be available to everyone.

Talkspace pioneered the ability to text with a licensed therapist from anywhere and now offers a comprehensive suite of mental health services, including therapy for individuals, teens, and couples, as well as psychiatric treatment and medication management (18+). With Talkspace’s core therapy offerings, members are matched with one of thousands of licensed therapists within days and can engage in live video, audio, or chat sessions, and/or unlimited asynchronous text messaging sessions.

All care offered at Talkspace is delivered through an easy-to-use, fully-encrypted web and mobile platform that meets HIPAA, federal, and state regulatory requirements. More than 151 million Americans have access to Talkspace through their health insurance plans, employee assistance programs, our partnerships with leading healthcare companies, or as a free benefit through their employer, school, or government agency.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

raw.excerpt: DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change.
raw.description:
DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change. Through innovative programs, relevant partnerships, and exceptional care, we empower students to meaningfully improve their lives, communities, and workplaces.

Opportunity:

DeVry University focuses on developing long-term relationships with superior instructors who have high professional standards, excellent communication skills, enthusiasm and a commitment to providing the finest practitioner-focused education. We are seeking primarily industry professionals to teach and share their knowledge and experience with undergraduate and graduate students in a variety of fields.

  • Courses meet once or twice a week for eight weeks.
  • Face-to-face interaction is blended with technology (such as online discussions and online assignments) for an enhanced learning environment.
  • Faculty are responsible for facilitating student learning by teaching courses and programs in accordance with DeVry University requirements.
  • Faculty develop course syllabi and lesson plans and apply teaching techniques to best achieve course and programmatic objectives.
  • All DeVry instructors will participate in a comprehensive faculty training program and ongoing faculty development activities to ensure the highest quality instruction.
  • As you explore this opportunity, we invite you to view this brief video highlighting how our faculty engage in meaningful student support.

Responsibilities:

  • Develops and provides students with an approved DeVry University syllabus that follows a template established by the local campus, and which includes the terminal course objectives.
  • Organizes, prepares, and regularly revises and update all course materials.
  • Uses appropriate technological options for online technologies and course-related software, including Websites, e-mail, and online discussions for preparing the course and making it accessible to students.
  • Models effective oral and written communications that engage the students, provide clarity, and improve student learning.
  • Sets clear expectations for the course by publishing course terminal objectives, assignment/examinations dates, and weight the distribution of various evaluation categories.
  • Ensures that the content and level of material included on exams correspond to the course terminal objectives.
  • Demonstrates consistency and fairness in the preparation and grading of exams, and provide timely feedback to students.
  • Embraces and integrates the responsible use of AI technologies in the classroom to enhance teaching and learning outcomes.
  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize, evaluate, and address appropriate and inappropriate student use of AI tools in academic work.
  • Completes other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • A doctorate in Cloud Computing, Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a closely related field is required, with at least 18 graduate credit hours in cloud computing, distributed systems, networking, cybersecurity, or a related computing discipline.

◦ Applicants must upload unofficial graduate-level transcripts with their application. ◦ Degrees must be awarded by an institution accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation, or by an international institution determined to hold equivalent accreditation.

  • Three to five years of applied professional experience in cloud computing, distributed infrastructure, virtualization, or cloud-native technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud architecture and cloud-enabled software development, including infrastructure provisioning, containerization, and deployment of applications within cloud platforms.
  • Industry-recognized certifications or professional credentials relevant to cloud computing, cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or DevOps practices.
  • Strong subject matter expertise in cloud technologies, combined with effective communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse learners.
  • Knowledge of secure and responsible cloud operations, including identity and access management, data protection, regulatory considerations, and cloud security best practices.
  • Faculty must have a commitment to ongoing professional development in instructional technology, digital literacy, and responsible AI practices.
  • Additional requirements driven by state licensing, institutional policy, or accreditation standards may apply.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Industry certifications in cloud platforms or cloud architecture (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or equivalent industry-recognized credentials).
  • Experience with cloud-native development practices, including containerization, microservices architecture, serverless computing, and orchestration technologies.
  • Experience implementing DevSecOps frameworks, including continuous integration, continuous delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated security practices.
  • Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including workload migration, cloud cost management, and cloud governance.
  • Experience with programmatic or regional accreditation processes, including outcomes assessment, curriculum mapping, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Active membership or engagement in professional technology or cloud-related organizations to maintain current industry knowledge.
  • Experience integrating cloud-based laboratories, virtualized environments, or platform-based learning environments into post-secondary instruction to support hands-on learning.
  • Two to five years of teaching experience at the post-secondary level, preferably in cloud computing, networking, systems administration, cybersecurity, or software development.

Pay:

Visiting Professor pay is based on level, credit hours taught per 8-week session, and location.

  • Pay may vary in most states from $1500-$2700 per 8-week session.
  • Pay in the states of AZ, CA, IN and PA is paid at an hourly rate of either $22.00/hour or $23.50/hour.

For Visiting Professor roles, we accept applications on an ongoing basis. DeVry University offers benefit options for Visiting Professors, including:

  • 401(k) and Roth Plan
  • Paid Tuition Program
  • Remote and Flex Work Options
  • Paid Sick Time
  • Technology Stipend

We believe that a vibrant and collaborative workplace is essential to our educational mission and the success of our community. We are committed to a workplace environment where all colleagues feel valued, respected, and supported.
