SKEELO: EMBARQUE NA JORNADA QUE COLOCA A LEITURA NO CENTRO DE TUDO. 🐿️

QUEM SOMOS 💚

O Skeelo é uma plataforma digital de leitura que conecta pessoas a e-books, audiobooks e minibooks em uma experiência acessível e personalizada. Desde 2019, usamos a tecnologia como um meio para democratizar o acesso à leitura e ampliar seu impacto no desenvolvimento das pessoas.

Acreditamos que ler vai além do lazer: é uma ferramenta poderosa para expandir repertórios, fortalecer o pensamento crítico e impulsionar o desenvolvimento humano.

NOSSA VIBE 💚

Estamos distribuídos e distribuídas pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, movidos por inovação, agilidade e aprendizado contínuo, que valoriza a diversidade e transforma a leitura para se adaptar à vida das pessoas. Fazemos tudo isso com transparência nas relações, coragem para inovar, foco em alta performance, olhar constante para encantar clientes e leitores e entregas ágeis que fazem a diferença.

Nosso modelo de trabalho é remote first, tirando o melhor do home office: autorresponsabilidade com autonomia. Porém também acreditamos na conexão e trocas dos encontros presenciais, desse modo, temos alguns encontros presenciais em São Paulo - SP, para conexão com os demais Skeelers. Mas relaxa, o Skeelo sempre organiza tudo pra gente.

O time de Engenharia da squad de Publisher está precisando de alguém, e queremos você com a gente!

Sua missão? Mais do que desenvolver funcionalidades, esperamos alguém que participe das decisões técnicas, influencie a arquitetura dos sistemas, eleve o nível de engenharia do time e ajude a construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis.

O seu dia a dia no Skeelo vai ser assim:

  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de média e alta complexidade, sendo referência para outros desenvolvedores.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir serviços utilizando Node.js, com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e performance.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir APIs REST e GraphQL, garantindo contratos bem definidos e integrações confiáveis.
  • Participar das decisões de arquitetura, propondo soluções que equilibrem simplicidade, custo operacional e escalabilidade.
  • Trabalhar em uma arquitetura distribuída baseada em eventos, contribuindo para sistemas resilientes e desacoplados.
  • Atuar na evolução da observabilidade dos serviços utilizando métricas, logs e traces para apoiar decisões e reduzir tempo de resolução de incidentes.
  • Participar de code reviews, refinamentos técnicos, definição de padrões e evolução contínua da plataforma.
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Mobile e outros para entregar soluções de ponta a ponta.
  • Explorar automações e ferramentas de IA para aumentar produtividade, qualidade de código e eficiência operacional.

Para isso, você vai precisar ter:

  • Sólida experiência com Node.js e TypeScript.
  • Domínio na construção de APIs REST e/ou GraphQL.
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL e MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento em mensageria e arquitetura orientada a eventos.
  • Conhecimento em Redis e mecanismos de cache.
  • Vivência com testes automatizados, CI/CD e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Experiência com observabilidade utilizando ferramentas como Datadog, Kibana, Sentry ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e boas práticas de escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando impacto de negócio.
  • Conhecimento em GitHub Actions e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento em RabbitMQ ou Kafka.
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para compartilhar conhecimento, apoiar o crescimento do time e influenciar tecnicamente.

E seria muito bom se você também tivesse:

  • Experiência com Fastify.
  • Vivência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Experiência com ElasticSearch/OpenSearch.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas de alto volume e missão crítica.

  • Experiência utilizando IA no desenvolvimento de software (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code ou similares).

raw.description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

OneSpan is looking for a Senior Manager, Digital Demand Generation to lead digital pipeline generation for our Security business.

This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful ownership: paid media strategy and investment, digital sponsorships, campaign orchestration, experimentation, performance analysis and optimization. You'll also play an important role in the go-to-market motion behind DigipassONE, including our investment in passkeys.

The mandate is straightforward: build a repeatable, scalable digital demand engine that creates qualified pipeline and becomes more efficient over time.

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, deeply analytical and never satisfied with simply knowing what happened. You want to understand why it happened, what the data is telling you and what should change as a result.

What You'll Own

  • Lead paid digital strategy and execution for the Security business across search, social, display/programmatic, retargeting, content syndication and other relevant channels.
  • Own digital sponsorships and programs with industry publications, associations and other third parties.
  • Manage digital media investment and continuously reallocate budget based on performance and pipeline contribution.
  • Build the digital components of integrated Security campaigns, translating campaign strategy into channel mix, sequencing, offers, asset requirements, conversion paths and measurement.
  • Lead digital activation across 1:1, 1:few and 1:many account-based programs.
  • Develop and execute webinars and other virtual programs when they are the right vehicle for the audience and objective.
  • Partner with Product Marketing on audiences, positioning and campaign themes; Content and Creative on assets and offers; Marketing Operations on execution and measurement; and Demand Generation and Sales on pipeline progression.
  • Brief Creative and Content based on performance data, identifying where new messaging, formats, assets or offers could improve results.
  • Work closely with the teams responsible for the website, SEO/AEO and organic discovery to create strong conversion paths and a seamless prospect journey.
  • Use retargeting and digital engagement throughout the funnel, including active opportunities, rather than treating lead capture as the end of the digital journey.
  • Maintain a rigorous test-and-learn program across channels, audiences, creative, messaging, offers and conversion experiences.
  • Independently analyze performance data and turn it into clear recommendations for investment, optimization and future campaigns.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Built a repeatable, scalable digital pipeline engine responsible for a meaningful share of Marketing-sourced new-logo Security pipeline.
  • Improved conversion rates while reducing cost per qualified opportunity.
  • Established clear channel and program economics that connect marketing investment to opportunities, pipeline and revenue.
  • Built a disciplined optimization cadence that identifies what to scale, improve or stop.
  • Created an experimentation program that consistently produces actionable learning across audiences, channels, creative and offers.
  • Successfully translated Security priorities into integrated digital programs with clear objectives, sequencing and measurement.
  • Strengthened conversion throughout the buyer journey, from initial engagement through active opportunity.
  • Established digital performance as a source of insight for the broader Marketing team, influencing campaign strategy, content, creative and investment decisions.

What You'll Bring

We're less interested in an arbitrary number of years than we are in evidence that you've done this successfully before. However, success in this role typically aligns to folks with 7+ years in B2B digital/demand generation with meaningful enterprise SaaS experience.

We’re looking for:

  • A strong track record of creating B2B pipeline through digital demand generation, preferably in cybersecurity, enterprise software or another complex B2B market.
  • Deep knowledge of paid digital media and the ability to determine the right channel mix based on the business objective rather than personal channel preference.
  • Experience owning meaningful media budgets and making investment decisions based on downstream performance.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently work with campaign, funnel, opportunity and pipeline data.
  • Experience optimizing beyond clicks, form fills and MQLs to qualified opportunities, pipeline and revenue.
  • Experience building integrated campaigns across multiple channels and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Strong understanding of audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion optimization and account-based marketing.
  • Excellent program management skills and the ability to drive execution across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Salesforce, marketing automation, web analytics and business intelligence tools.
  • The judgment to know when to optimize an investment and when to stop it.
  • The curiosity to challenge assumptions, test new approaches and change your position when the evidence says you should.

Even Better If You Have

  • Experience working at a digital marketing or advertising agency, where demonstrating measurable client return was essential to retaining and growing the business.
  • Experience both working within and managing external agencies.
  • Cybersecurity, identity or authentication experience.
  • Experience marketing to highly regulated industries.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience.
  • Experience supporting sophisticated ABM programs.

How We Work

  • We don't expect every experiment to work but fail early, fail often as needed.
  • We want people who are willing to challenge conventional B2B marketing, test ideas others haven't tried and learn quickly. Nothing is protected simply because we've always done it that way.
  • Come with a hypothesis. Define how we'll know whether it worked. Test it. Read the evidence. Then scale it, improve it or stop it.
  • This role begins as a senior individual contributor. Build the engine, demonstrate incremental pipeline and prove that additional investment can scale it, and there is an opportunity to build a team around the function.

You’ll be joining a talented, collaborative Marketing team that cares deeply about the work, the results and each other. We challenge assumptions, share what we’re learning, step in when someone needs help and hold ourselves to a high standard without taking ourselves too seriously. We want this to be a place where you can do some of the best work of your career, learn from great people and continue to grow. There is a lot of exciting work ahead, and we’re genuinely looking forward to welcoming the next great person to the team.

Salary: $160,000 - $175,000 (depending on experience and qualifications) plus bonus.

raw.description:
We're Looking for an Accounting Policy Intern!

About the Company:

Security Benefit is a leader in the U.S. retirement market with more than $60 billion in assets under management. We offer opportunities to thrive, innovate, and make an impact. As part of our team, you’ll play a key role in driving the future of the U.S. retirement industry. Security Benefit is a PLACE where we promise to help our customers To and Through Retirement®. We’re proud to have been recognized as one of the best in the business:

  • Named to Ward’s 50 list of top-performing life-health insurance companies
  • Recognized on list of Ingram’s Top 100 Private Companies in the Kansas City area in 2024

About the Role:

As an Accounting Policy Intern, you’ll be an integral part of a collaborative, agile team. The Intern position reports to the Accounting Policy Director and can be performed remotely or in a hybrid capacity from our Topeka or Overland Park, Kansas offices. We built this internship to work around your semester. Start at 10-20 hours/week, flex up during breaks or summer if you want more, and stay on with us across multiple semesters. You’ll get hands-on experience with how our team uses AI in technical accounting, helping build and improve the tools and workflows we rely on and shaping how the function works day to day. What is Accounting Policy? Accounting Policy is the team that determines the right accounting treatment for Security Benefit’s most complex, new, or unusual transactions, and how new accounting standards apply to the company. It interprets FASB and NAIC guidance, sets the company’s position on emerging issues, and helps partner teams apply that guidance consistently. It’s the “how do we account for this, and why” function.

  • Use AI tools and agents to help build and organize a technical accounting knowledge repository, capturing research, precedent, and accounting positions in a structured, searchable format
  • Gain exposure to emerging U.S. GAAP and Statutory accounting guidance (FASB, NAIC) by supporting research on real transactions
  • Assist with maintaining and enhancing regulatory tracking tools and summaries for internal stakeholders
  • Provide support on PBBD (Principles-Based Bond Definition) initiatives, including documentation of decision frameworks and onboarding considerations
  • Assist in drafting summaries and supporting materials for accounting policy memos and internal presentations
  • Help document and streamline Accounting Policy processes and procedures, including how the team uses AI tools day to day
  • Participate in cross-functional discussions (as appropriate) to gain exposure to investment accounting, financial reporting, and actuarial impacts

What We’re Looking For:

Students eligible for the internship will be current, full-time students available to begin immediately.

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in accounting, finance, or a related field, with a genuine interest in technical accounting (no prior technical accounting coursework or work experience required).
  • Curiosity about AI tools and agents (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) and interest in applying them to real business and research problems
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • A willingness to learn and develop industry-related knowledge.
  • Effective communication skills, both verbally and in written form.
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to work independently with guidance.
  • Comfortable learning new software quickly; proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel is a plus.
  • Willingness to work and learn in multiple financial systems.
  • A team player with a collaborative mindset.

Why Choose Security Benefit? When you join our team, you’re not just getting a paycheck — you’re getting a career path full of growth opportunities, plus a robust benefits package that puts your well-being first. Here’s what you can expect as part of our internship program at Security Benefit:

  • Hands-on Experience
  • Skill Development
  • Networking Opportunities
  • Resume Enhancement
  • Exploration of Career Paths
  • Personal and Professional Growth
  • Industry Insights
  • Holiday Pay

This isn’t a summer-only program; it’s a pipeline into our Accounting Policy function. Because the role runs across multiple semesters, you can grow with the team, take on more over time, and help build the foundation for a career in technical accounting. Ready to Make an Impact? Apply today by visiting our career page to submit your resume. We’re excited to meet you! Security Benefit is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

About LOVB (League One Volleyball):
League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. In this role, you will join a mission-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves team of innovators and builders who have come together to change the paradigm of professional volleyball and women’s sports.

Direct Report: Manager, FP&A Pro

Job Summary:

The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) will lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis for LOVB Pro. This highly visible role will translate financial data into strategic insights, build scalable financial processes, and partner closely with executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and other key stakeholders to support informed business decisions.

The Director will serve as a trusted financial advisor while supporting a growing organization at the intersection of sports, entertainment, and strategy. This role requires deep FP&A expertise, strong business judgment, an entrepreneurial mindset, and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Support the organization's annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.
  • Develop financial models and analyses that support business planning and strategic decision-making for the existing business and new initiatives.
  • Monitor financial performance, identify trends, and provide clear, actionable insights to senior leadership.
  • Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Own workforce cost planning, including headcount and compensation cost modeling, and sporting cost and labor economics, including player, coach, and staff budgeting, forecasting, and cost controls, as part of the annual budget and ongoing forecasts.
  • Own weekly rolling cash flow reporting and forecasting.

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Partner with executive leadership on financial strategy, business performance, and key organizational decisions.
  • Support financial reporting and presentations for the Board of Directors and other key stakeholders.
  • Translate complex financial information and results into clear, accessible insights for non-finance stakeholders.
  • Serve as a strategic financial partner across functions, helping leaders understand the financial implications of business decisions.
  • Present unit economics analysis to leadership on a monthly basis.

Financial Controls, Reporting & Compliance

  • Support sound financial controls and adherence to GAAP accounting standards.
  • Partner with Accounting and Finance leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial reporting.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors and support audit processes and deliverables.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive financial and organizational information.
  • Prepare a monthly business reporting package containing the prior month's balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement, including variance analysis.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and improve scalable FP&A processes, tools, reporting, and operating rhythms as the organization grows.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial visibility, efficiency, and decision-making.
  • Support special projects, business analyses, and emerging priorities as needed.
  • Contribute to a collaborative Finance culture while maintaining strong professional standards and attention to detail.
  • Partner with the Senior Accounting Manager to refine and audit NetSuite functionality.
  • Support the CFO in tracking and improving Finance & Accounting process KPIs.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Deep knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.
  • Deep knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling.
  • Strong working knowledge of GAAP accounting principles and financial controls.
  • Strong strategic and business acumen with the ability to connect financial performance to organizational priorities.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with executives and other senior stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion.
  • Ability to operate strategically while remaining comfortable with hands-on execution.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and evolving environment.
  • Collaborative approach with humility, kindness, and strong interpersonal skills.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field required.
  • 5–10 years of progressive FP&A or related financial experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and financial analysis.
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership, Boards, and other high-value stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting growing businesses, new initiatives, or entrepreneurial/intrapreneurial projects.
  • Experience working with external auditors.
  • Experience within professional sports, entertainment, or another high-growth industry preferred.
  • Experience within an early-stage or rapidly scaling organization preferred.
  • Genuine interest in sports and entertainment, with enthusiasm for the growth of women's sports and volleyball.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements (Remote):

  • Ability to operate a computer and use a keyboard, mouse, and video conferencing tools.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through video, phone, and written channels.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment.
  • Periodic travel required for key meetings and events.
  • Occasional evening and weekend availability may be required during peak business periods.

Why LOVB Pro?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the financial backbone of an organization growing at the forefront of women's sports. You'll have real influence, direct access to leadership, and the chance to build something meaningful in a mission-driven, high-energy environment.

raw.excerpt: DescriptionCompany OverviewCapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners.
raw.description:
Description

Company Overview

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across Marketing, IT, Analytics, CRO, and Media Buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Strategist who thinks like a strategist, creative person and optimizer—someone who understands customer behavior, identifies growth opportunities, and continuously improves marketing performance through experimentation.

You'll be responsible for developing new funnels, conducting market and competitor research, generating hypotheses, managing A/B testing initiatives, and collaborating closely with Creative, Media Buying, Analytics, and IT teams to deliver measurable business results.

Success in this role means constantly asking "How can we improve conversion?" and using data to find the answer.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct market, audience, and competitor research for new and existing clients.
  • Develop new landing page concepts and marketing funnels.
  • Generate, prioritize, and document CRO hypotheses.
  • Plan and manage A/B testing roadmaps across multiple clients.
  • Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Copywriters, Designers, Video Producers, IT, and Media Buyers throughout the production process.
  • Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
  • Identify winning strategies and scale them across similar clients and industries.
  • Maintain and expand the company's CRO knowledge base and testing library.
  • Research new marketing trends, technologies, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
  • Present recommendations and optimization plans to internal stakeholders.

AI & Experimentation Mindset

You actively use AI to improve research, productivity, and decision-making. Whether it's generating hypotheses, analyzing competitors, organizing knowledge, or accelerating content creation, you view AI as a strategic assistant rather than a replacement for marketing thinking.

We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and continuously improving existing processes.

Requirements

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization.
  • Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests.
  • Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills.
  • Proficient English language skills.
  • Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries.
  • Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube.
  • Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization.
  • Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

raw.excerpt: Karriereservice;de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, persönliche Entwicklungsarbeit, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement.
raw.description:
Karriereservice;de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, persönliche Entwicklungsarbeit, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement. Wir begleiten Menschen in unterschiedlichen beruflichen und persönlichen Situationen: Beim Einstieg in das Berufsleben, während des Studiums, in Veränderungsphasen, bei der beruflichen Neuorientierung und auf dem Weg zum nächsten Karriereschritt.

Dabei betrachten wir Karriere nicht isoliert. Berufliche Entscheidungen sind häufig eng mit persönlichen Zielen, individuellen Stärken, Selbstvertrauen, Beziehungen und herausfordernden Lebenssituationen verbunden. Deshalb können unsere Coachings über klassische Karriere- und Bewerbungsthemen hinausgehen und auch Fragen der Persönlichkeitsentwicklung, Entscheidungsfindung oder Konfliktbewältigung einbeziehen.

Zu unseren Auftraggebenden und Kunden zählen Unternehmen, Hochschulen, öffentliche Institutionen sowie Privatpersonen. Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Coachingangebots suchen wir engagierte Karriere-, Job- und Bewerbungscoaches (m/w/d), die uns freiberuflich bei der Durchführung unterschiedlicher Coachingaufträge unterstützen.

Aufgaben

Je nach Auftrag, Zielgruppe und persönlichem Schwerpunkt übernimmst Du unter anderem:

  • Die Durchführung individueller Karriere-, Job- und Bewerbungscoachings
  • Begleitung von Studierenden, Berufseinsteigenden, Berufserfahrenen und Menschen in beruflichen Veränderungssituationen
  • Unterstützung bei beruflicher Standortbestimmung, Zielklärung und Karriereplanung
  • Reflexion persönlicher Stärken, Werte, Interessen und Entwicklungspotenziale
  • Begleitung bei Entscheidungsprozessen und der Entwicklung tragfähiger
    beruflicher Perspektiven
  • Unterstützung bei der persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, beispielsweise hinsichtlich Selbstvertrauen, Selbstwirksamkeit, Kommunikation oder Abgrenzungsfähigkeit
  • Begleitung bei Konflikten im Studium, am Arbeitsplatz oder mit Arbeitgebenden
  • Unterstützung im Umgang mit beruflichen Belastungen, Unsicherheiten und Veränderungssituationen
  • Analyse und Optimierung von Lebensläufen, Anschreiben und Bewerbungsstrategien
  • Vorbereitung auf Vorstellungsgespräche, Auswahlverfahren und Gehaltsverhandlungen
  • Verlässliche Dokumentation und organisatorische Begleitung der jeweiligen Coachingprozesse
  • Kooperative Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team, um die Anliegen der Coachees und die Rahmenbedingungen der Auftraggebenden professionell miteinander zu verbinden

Die genaue Ausgestaltung richtet sich nach dem individuellen Anliegen der Coachees. Die Coachings können – abhängig vom jeweiligen Projekt – in Präsenz, remote (vorwiegend) oder in einem hybriden Format stattfinden.

Qualifikation

Wir freuen uns über Coaches (m/w/d) mit unterschiedlichen beruflichen und fachlichen Hintergründen. Entscheidend sind für uns ein professionelles Coachingverständnis, persönliche Zugewandtheit und die Fähigkeit, Menschen wirksam in Entwicklungs- und Veränderungsprozessen zu begleiten.

Idealerweise verfügst Du über:

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Karriere-, Job-, Bewerbungs-, Konflikt- oder Life-Coaching
  • Eine fundierte Coachingausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Ein ganzheitliches Verständnis beruflicher und persönlicher Entwicklungsprozesse
  • Kenntnisse des Arbeitsmarktes sowie aktueller Bewerbungs- und Auswahlprozesse
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen und beruflichen Erfahrungsstufen
  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie eine wertschätzende und verbindliche Gesprächsführung
  • Die Fähigkeit, Ressourcen und Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam realistische Lösungen zu entwickeln
  • Einen professionellen Umgang mit den Grenzen des eigenen Coachingauftrags
  • Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Verbindlichkeit und Diskretion
  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit digitalen Coachingformaten
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; weitere Sprachen sind willkommen

Auch qualifizierte Coaches (m/w/d), die am Anfang ihrer freiberuflichen Tätigkeit stehen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen, sich bei uns vorzustellen.

Benefits

Das bieten wir Dir:

  • Eine langfristig angelegte freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit
  • Vielfältige Coachingaufträge mit unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen und Themenstellungen
  • Flexible Einsatzmöglichkeiten in Präsenz, remote oder hybrid
  • Eine transparente und verlässliche Abstimmung
  • Fachlichen Austausch mit einem erfahrenen Team
  • Gestaltungsspielraum bei der methodischen Umsetzung
  • Die Möglichkeit, eigene fachliche Schwerpunkte und Erfahrungen einzubringen
  • Eine wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe

Interesse an einer Zusammenarbeit?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich und Deinen Coachingansatz kennenzulernen!

Sende uns bitte eine kurze Vorstellung mit Deinem beruflichen Hintergrund, Deinen Coachingqualifikationen, Deinen fachlichen Schwerpunkten, Deinen möglichen Einsatzregionen beziehungsweise Remote-Kapazitäten.

Gern kannst Du außerdem Deinen Lebenslauf, relevante Zertifikate und – sofern vorhanden – Referenzen beifügen.

Wir melden uns zeitnah bei Dir und besprechen in einem persönlichen Gespräch, welche Coachingaufträge und Formen der Zusammenarbeit gut zu Deinem Profil passen könnten.

raw.description:
gestalte mit uns die energiewende

Wir von TESVOLT Energy machen es für Betreiber kleiner und mittlerer Batteriespeicher erstmals möglich, lukrativ am Flexibilitätshandel teilzunehmen. Bisher hatten sie keine Chance, einen guten Trader zu finden, der ihre kleineren Speicherkapazitäten an der Energiebörse handelt. Wir bringen sie gebündelt als virtuelles Kraftwerk ans Netz – gehandelt durch die besten Trader am Markt.

Unsere Arbeit ist technisch anspruchsvoll, datenbasiert und nah an der Praxis. Genau das begeistert unser Team: ein Umfeld, in dem Analyst:innen, Entwickler:innen und Strateg:innen gemeinsam etwas bewegen können.

Du denkst Infrastruktur nicht nur mit, sondern voraus? Du willst Systeme bauen, die stabil, sicher und skalierbar sind – und gleichzeitig Entwicklerteams empowern? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

deine aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Vertriebsteam im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles vorbereitet ist, damit sich unser Sales Manager und unsere Account Manager auf ihre Kunden und Partner konzentrieren können.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Erlösprojektionen und
    Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen für Batteriespeicherprojekte und bereitest die Ergebnisse übersichtlich für Kunden und Partner auf.
  • Du bereitest Kunden- und Projektdaten auf und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Angeboten, Präsentationen und weiteren Vertriebsunterlagen.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Bearbeitung neuer Kunden- und Partneranfragen und bereitest
    relevante Informationen für die weitere Bearbeitung durch unser Vertriebsteam vor.
  • Du pflegst Kunden-, Partner- und Projektdaten in unserem CRM und stellst sicher, dass Informationen vollständig und aktuell dokumentiert sind.
  • Du unterstützt bei vertrieblichen Prozessen und Follow-ups und behältst offene Aufgaben und nächste Schritte im Blick.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales Manager, den Account Managern sowie Energy-Market und Operations-Kolleg:innen zusammen und unterstützt dort, wo im laufenden Vertriebsprozess zusätzliche Kapazität benötigt wird.

dein profil

  • Du absolvierst ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft, BWL, Energiewirtschaft,
    Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Finance oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Du hast Interesse an Energiewirtschaft, Batteriespeichern und Energiehandel und möchtest verstehen, wie daraus konkrete Geschäftsmodelle und Kundenprojekte entstehen.
  • Du hast Spaß am Umgang mit Zahlen und Daten und kannst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen.
  • Du arbeitest sehr strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig – auch wenn mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig laufen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1). Dies ist für die Position zwingend erforderlich.
  • Du verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office und insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint.
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit CRM-Systemen, Datenanalyse, Energiewirtschaft oder im Vertrieb sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und ein wachsendes Vertriebsteam hands-on zu unterstützen.
  • Du schätzt die Dynamik eines jungen Start-ups und gleichzeitig die Zugehörigkeit zu einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe.

warum wir?

raw.description:
Are you an Analytics Engineering Lead, who knows exactly how to bridge the gap between raw data engineering and high-impact business insights? Read on to find out more!

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behavior-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short video.

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

We are open to remote work for this position and will happily accept applicants from anywhere in Portugal, Kenya and South Africa.

The Job

In this role, you will define the technical strategy for our data environment while mentoring another Analytics Engineering Senior to build, maintain, and scale reliable, well-documented data models. Sitting right at the center of our data ecosystem, you will collaborate across Data Engineering, Analytics, Product, Finance, and Operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Modelling & Semantic Architecture: Oversee the architecture of performant, cost-effective dbt and Tableau data models, establishing clean semantic layers with validated metrics, standardized business logic, and dimensional modeling best practices.
  • Governance & Engineering Standards: Enforce software best practices (CI/CD, Git, automated testing) alongside data contracts and playbooks to ensure exceptional data reliability and elevate organizational self-service analytics.
  • Technical Leadership & Enablement: Mentor and grow the analytics engineering team while bridging the gap between Data Engineers, Analysts, Product, and Architecture to align technical strategy with core business goals.
  • You document your work and make sure that your documentation is clear and understandable for future use by others.
  • Our team works in an agile way, and you will be part of the rituals and practices.

About you

You care deeply about the business context behind the numbers, not just the pipelines that process them. You sit naturally at the intersection of software engineering discipline and business strategy. You are a builder and a mentor who takes pride in turning chaotic raw tables into clean, trustworthy semantic layers, and you get genuine satisfaction from enabling analysts and non-technical stakeholders to self-serve with total confidence.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, or guiding data teams, alongside strong stakeholder management experience (particularly with Product and Architecture leads)
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Analytics Engineering and BI Engineering
  • Advanced proficiency with dbt, SQL, and analytics-focused data modelling (dimensional modelling, ELT/ETL design)
  • Strong experience building and optimising data models within Tableau
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD, Git, automated testing, pull request workflows, and modern data stack tooling
  • Exceptional ability to translate complex technical data concepts into clear, business-friendly language
  • Fluent written and verbal English skills
  • You are currently based in Portugal / South Africa / Kenya

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Airflow or workflow orchestration tools
  • Background in Data Engineering, cloud data warehouses, or lakehouse architectures
  • Exposure to streaming architectures / event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis)
  • Hands-on experience building dedicated metric layers (dbt Semantic Layer, MetricFlow, LookML)

Recruitment Process

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Tech Team | Technical Challenge | Final interview with the Tech Team

The Rewards

The gross monthly salary brackets for this position are:

Kenya: Ksh444,178 - Ksh740,000 (x12)

South Africa: R88,008 - R146,600 (x12)

Portugal: €3,660 - €6,100 (x14)

Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

  • Benefits and allowances tailored to your location.
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options.
  • A personal development budget of €500 per year to invest in your professional growth
  • Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge.
  • The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
  • A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website Tiko – Do more with Tiko. We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

  • Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
  • Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.
  • Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. As part of this scheme, we will request information from your previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during your employment, or incidents under investigation when you left employment. By applying for this position, you confirm you have read and understood these recruitment procedures.
We value your privacy and understand the importance of safeguarding your personal data. We invite you to review our privacy notice for the recruitment process to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. Click here to view the document. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have read and understood our privacy notice.

---

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

A senior-level cloud support engineering role with real operational depth — not a helpdesk function, not a ticket-routing seat. You'll be the technical owner of cloud platform support across a multi-cloud environment, working on the infrastructure that keeps enterprise-grade SaaS and PaaS products running. If you've spent years on AWS operations, know your way around Kubernetes and Terraform in production, and thrive in an on-call, fast-response culture, this is a contract with substance and scope.

---

**PROJECT & CONTEXT**

You'll join a cloud operations team responsible for supporting, configuring, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure across AWS (primary), GCP, Azure, and OpenStack. The environment spans containerised workloads on Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Java application stacks (Tomcat, JBoss), and Linux-based systems — all running at enterprise scale. The role includes on-call pager duty responsibilities and requires the ability to diagnose and resolve complex, multi-layer cloud, network, and access issues with minimal escalation. Contract runs until **31 August 2027**, starting ASAP.

---

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Experience**

  • Senior-level background in **cloud support, cloud operations, or platform engineering**
  • **Fluent English** — written and spoken, for incident communication and cross-team collaboration

**Cloud Platforms**

  • **AWS** — mandatory, hands-on production experience (2+ years)
  • Strong command of **IAM, VPC networking, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Config, and Backup**
  • Experience with **AWS multi-account architecture and governance**
  • Working knowledge of **GCP, Azure, or OpenStack** (at least one additional platform)
  • Solid understanding of cloud computing fundamentals: **IaaS, PaaS, SaaS**
  • Experience configuring and optimising cloud resources: **VPC, IAM, Auto Scaling**

**Container Orchestration & Infrastructure**

  • **Kubernetes** — 2+ years of hands-on experience in production environments
  • **Docker** and VM-based workload management
  • **Terraform** for infrastructure provisioning and change management
  • **Helm charts** for Kubernetes application deployment

**CI/CD & Tooling**

  • CI/CD pipeline experience — Git-based workflows and automation tooling (2+ years)
  • Familiarity with **Rundeck** for operational job scheduling and automation
  • **Grafana** for monitoring and observability
  • **JIRA** for incident and change tracking

**Application Stack & Scripting**

  • Experience supporting **Java application stacks**: Tomcat, JBoss, MySQL (2+ years)
  • **Linux** system administration and troubleshooting (3+ years)
  • Scripting proficiency in **Bash, Python, and/or Zsh**

**Security & Compliance**

  • Hands-on implementation of **security configurations, access controls, and IAM best practices**
  • Working knowledge of **cloud security standards** and governance frameworks

**On-Call Operations**

  • **On-call pager duty** experience (1+ year) — comfortable owning incidents outside business hours

---

**NICE TO HAVE**

  • Familiarity with **FinOps Foundation** concepts and cloud cost optimisation frameworks
  • Experience with **Windows system administration** alongside Linux
  • **PowerShell** scripting in a hybrid or Windows-adjacent cloud environment
  • Exposure to **OpenStack** private cloud operations
  • Background in **enterprise SaaS or PaaS platform support** at scale

Primarily responsible for oversight of the assigned Validation teams to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery of computer system validation activities supporting general releases and patches/hot fixes. Plan and drive complex validation tasks (periodic review, new product introduction) across the Validation teams while advancing modern validation practices, including test automation strategies and the governance and validation of AI-driven capabilities. Mentor and develop leaders of the assigned Validation teams providing technical validation expertise, interpretation, and direction to assure compliance with GxP (GMP, GCP, Device) regulatory requirements, company policies and standards regarding validation, document control and change management.
Additional responsibility is to support the audit management function by presenting CSV operations during customer audits.

What You'll Do

  • Manage/mentor a validation team of validation program managers / team leads (direct reports) on validation projects of Veeva and internal business systems to ensure deliverables conform to company and regulatory requirements
  • Responsible to deliver validation projects under strict deadlines to ensure customer success. Review and approve validation approach, method, and reporting (VPP, VIA, VSR) during periodic releases of Veeva software products
  • Establish validation processes commensurate with the level of risk and manage the execution of validation projects whose scope, regulatory visibility, schedule requirements, and complexity require coordination with customers, collaborators, and quality
  • Oversee on-shore and off-shore team of validation contractors testing of Veeva products to ensure deliverables conform to defined budgets and timelines
  • Act as executive management interface between Product Development, Operations, Security, and Quality Assurance/Compliance regarding Computer Systems validation exigencies and problem resolution
  • Support planning and execution of product and internal system periodic reviews
  • Execute other projects/duties as assigned to ensure compliance across Veeva’s product line and internal business systems

Requirements

  • Knowledge of Software Engineering and Quality Assurance generally attained through studies resulting in a B.S., in engineering/sciences, a related discipline, or its equivalent and applicable industry experience
  • 10+ years of directly relevant experience in validation of enterprise software, computer information systems used in life sciences regulated environment (GMP, GCP, GLP, GvP)
  • Hands-on experience or working knowledge of risk-based validation, compliance frameworks, and governance for AI/ML-enabled capabilities in life sciences software
  • Previous managerial experience (5+) which demonstrates proficiency in selection, motivating and retaining a superior team, effectively managing personnel issues and planning and administering financial resources
  • Demonstrated understanding of ERES regulations (e.g., 21 CFR Part 11, etc.)
  • Applied experience (i.e., through validation activities, audit support, and/or software system/software product compliance evaluation) in GCPs (e.g., ICH E6, 21 CFR 56, etc.), GMPs (e.g., 21 CRF 211, 21 CFR 820, etc.)
  • Use and/or development of risk-based, critical thinking decision-making models to inform validation related activities
  • Excellent project management, communication, and technical writing skills are required
  • The successful candidate will possess the professionalism and technical competency required to represent the department before our customers, regulatory agencies, and management
  • Proven ability working in a matrix environment and leading multi-level / cross functional teams to achieve the highest performance in meeting site and departmental objectives

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Agile SDLC, SaaS, AI, and/or IT cloud technologies
  • Awareness of various global standard frameworks such as ISO, SEI, ITIL
  • Exposure to global Health Authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, Health Canada, MHRA, etc.) with respect to computer system validation & data integrity
  • Experience with automated testing technologies

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission to get therapy into the hands of everyone!

We’re looking for a part-time, contract Therapist (Independent Contract Provider) who is passionate about reaching individuals who need mental healthcare but lack easy access to it. This role is perfect for those seeking the opportunity to work with a diverse client base while enjoying the flexibility and rewards of private practice—without the hassle of administrative work. Let Talkspace handle the insurance billing, marketing, and administrative costs, so you can create your own schedule and focus fully on providing impactful care!

What you'll do:

  • Treat clients remotely in your state(s) of licensure on the secure (HIPAA compliant) Talkspace platform
  • Conduct client sessions using video, audio, and live messaging services
  • Respond to asynchronous client messages each week, in a timely manner
  • Complete your required clinical documentation after each client session

About you

  • Current license to practice independently without supervision in the state of Rhode Island
    • Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW)
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
    • Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC)
  • Individual professional malpractice liability insurance policy
  • Individual NPI number
  • Comfortable learning new online tools and technology
  • Reliable internet connection and video-capable device

Perks

  • Clients Ready for You: Talkspace provides new client referrals
  • Flexible Schedule: Set your own schedule with no minimum requirement for your weekly hours or caseload size
  • No Membership Fees: No provider fees
  • Accept Insurance Without Hassle: Talkspace will take care of all aspects of client insurance including credentialing, billing, and claims
  • Everything in One Place: Sessions, clinical documentation, resources, and compensation tracking on one platform
  • Fully Paid Training: Master the Talkspace platform before your first session
  • Clinical Support: Provider Support and IT teams available for any technical or platform related questions
  • Free CEUs: NBCC and ASWB accredited continuing education credits via Talkspace-provided Learning Communities
  • Health Perks: Access Stride Health to support your health and financial well-being

Compensation

  • $70 per hour for live chat, audio, or video sessions (this rate is prorated for 45 and 30 minute sessions)
  • Additional compensation for asynchronous messaging
  • Earn a new client engagement bonus, varying by plan type

Please note: If you treat clients in multiple states, different rates will apply accordingly. Rates could be subject to change and may vary over time based on the market and shifts in demand.

Why Talkspace

Talkspace is a leading virtual behavioral healthcare provider committed to helping people lead healthier, happier lives through access to high-quality mental healthcare. At Talkspace, we believe that mental healthcare is core to overall health and should be available to everyone.

Talkspace pioneered the ability to text with a licensed therapist from anywhere and now offers a comprehensive suite of mental health services, including therapy for individuals, teens, and couples, as well as psychiatric treatment and medication management (18+). With Talkspace’s core therapy offerings, members are matched with one of thousands of licensed therapists within days and can engage in live video, audio, or chat sessions, and/or unlimited asynchronous text messaging sessions.

All care offered at Talkspace is delivered through an easy-to-use, fully-encrypted web and mobile platform that meets HIPAA, federal, and state regulatory requirements. More than 151 million Americans have access to Talkspace through their health insurance plans, employee assistance programs, our partnerships with leading healthcare companies, or as a free benefit through their employer, school, or government agency.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

raw.description:
Location: Remote- Eligible US Locations

About the role and about You:

As the Senior Engineering Manager for the Game Experience (GAMEX) team, you will directly manage a senior team of engineers focused on Zwift's core game loop – from new gamified experiences and competitive racing systems to real-time physics and experiences built on top of our widely-deployed game controller ecosystem. You will navigate technical and product ambiguity, drive alignment across game designers, product managers, program managers / producers, UX designers, engineers, and QA, and ensure our cross-platform C++ features are fun, engaging, and perform seamlessly across desktop, mobile, and Apple TV.

You will balance strategic leadership as a team/people manager with deep technical stewardship, guiding architectural decisions, setting a high bar for engineering quality, and fostering an environment where engineers can grow, deliver predictably (and without crunch), and do their best work.

If you're an experienced game engineering leader who excels at building agile, high-performing teams and owning complex game features from prototype to live production, please apply!

What you’ll do:

  • Lead and support a senior engineering team: Directly manage a dedicated team of 6-8 engineers and be responsible for coaching, career development, performance management, and hiring while fostering a culture of high-autonomy engineering excellence.
  • Drive technical architecture: Provide technical oversight for C++ gameplay systems, partnering with your engineers to ensure scalable and maintainable designs, optimal cross-platform performance, memory management, and long-term technical health.
  • Own the end-to-end software development life cycle: Zwift is a continuously evolving live-service game. You will own the operational excellence of your features in production, championing automated testing, feature flagging, phased rollouts, and real-time telemetry to safely experiment and iterate in a live environment.
  • Drive predictable delivery: Lead efficient, agile team processes (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) that empower the team to plan, iterate, and deliver predictably. You will manage incoming requests, own your team's roadmap, unblock your team, mitigate risks, and maintain clear visibility for stakeholders.
  • Navigate ambiguity: You'll drive cross-functional alignment between engineering, game design, product management, program management / producers, UX, QA, and hardware teams to establish a clear technical strategy and milestones for your team and projects.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years in a software engineering management role (e.g., Engineering Manager, Technical Director, or Lead Programmer/Engineer), with experience directly managing, coaching, and growing engineers in the games industry.
  • 6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience in game development, with deep fluency in C++ and commercial or custom game engines.
  • Strong understanding of game performance, profiling, memory management, and multi-platform game architecture.
  • Experience operating and maintaining features within a live-service game, with high standards for production quality, operational monitoring, phased deployments, feature flag management, and support.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently define technical strategy and team roadmaps while successfully navigating ambiguity and cross-team dependencies.
  • Proven ability to lead game engineering teams using modern agile practices to run sprints, mitigate delivery risks, and establish reliable release schedules in an iterative environment.

Bonus points:

  • Experience integrating game clients with backend services, persistence layers, and cross-platform mobile ecosystems like iOS, iPadOS, and Android.
  • Experience in console game development, including optimizing for performance and stability in constrained platforms (memory, processing power).
  • Experience integrating modern, AI-assisted development tools to unlock team productivity, balanced with mechanisms to help teams audit, maintain, and scale the use of agentically generated code.
  • Experience building gameplay systems that take advantage of external hardware controllers or physical inputs.
  • Experience with live-game experimentation, A/B testing, and using analytics tools or data pipelines to inform decisions (e.g., Amplitude, Databricks).
  • Interest in building products that support our engaged Zwift community of cyclists, runners, and fitness enthusiasts.

For All US Based Full-Time Positions:

The base salary for this position ranges between 149,500 to 238,500. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Zwift is proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes performance bonuses, equity, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

If Zwift determines in any stage of our interviews that any AI tools are being used without disclosure or citation, your candidacy will be disqualified.

How to stand out among the rest:

Your resume/CV is enough to show off your skills, accomplishments, and experience. However, if you choose to include a cover letter introducing us to your awesome personality, we will read that too.

We strongly believe that different backgrounds and ideas are a competitive advantage; we hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. Zwift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by emailing .

JOB Code - CEL/001

Researcher | Community Empowerment Lab (CEL)

Do you envision an organization beyond rigid structures and hierarchy – as a living, breathing system where people, learning, and energy flow purposefully?

Community Empowerment Lab (CEL) is a purpose-driven evidence-to-scale lab working to transform the care of mothers and newborns across India and the Global South. We work at the intersection of rigorous science and human experience, co-creating and scaling health systems and community-led solutions for maternal, newborn, and child health.

At CEL, we are sparking a movement where science and compassion come together to build a thriving world – one mother, one newborn, one community at a time.

To bring this vision alive from the inside out, within our research, we are seeking aResearcher, someone who can help shape CEL’s research architecture.

The Role

You will collaborate with the Director of Research Systems and a dynamic team of scientists to transform how CEL’s research delivers real-time impact for communities. By blending robust scientific expertise with an innovator’s mindset, you will challenge conventions, advance frontiers, and accelerate the translation of evidence into life-saving solutions. As a key leader, you will shape CEL’s approach to scientific inquiry and impact by designing research frameworks and collaborative methodologies grounded in compassion, rigour, and excellence. Through your guidance, CEL will cultivate a culture of continuous learning, dynamic knowledge exchange, and evidence-based innovation—ensuring our research generates new insights and delivers meaningful outcomes for the communities and partners we serve.

Your work will include:

• Lead the design of rigorous research protocols (cluster RCTs, implementation science, mixed-methods studies).

• Drive/Support proposal development, donor reporting, grant management, and ethical reviews.

• Supervise research teams, field operations, and ensure data quality and adherence to SOPs.

Culture Vitales is a global network which curates ‘Sessions of Vitality’ for companies and individuals - immersive experiences combining creativity, wellbeing, and personal/team development, designed to energize individuals, groups, leaders, and teams - which are both impactful and memorable.

We are looking for experts and practitioners in culture, wellbeing, development, arts and similar, who are interested in leading engaging workshops, sessions, programs, retreats and more.

YOUR SESSION(S):A session can be interactive (eg. a confidence workshop, art, cocktail-making) or passive (eg. meditation, music performance), or both.

Location: We are based globally including Paris, Sydney, Tallinn, New York, Singapore and more.

APPLICATION PROCESS

You can see more details on and apply here:

We’re especially looking for:

  • Artisans, creatives & artists (e.g. artisanal crafts, visual art/therapy, group improv, music, magic, writing, theatre, pottery, dance/movement workshops)

  • Coaches & development experts (e.g. communication, public speaking, systemic coaching, team-building, mindset, cross-cultural training, problem-solving, empathy)

  • Sensory & artisanal experts (e.g. perfumery, culinary experiences/cocktail-making, wine/tea pairing, body percussion, leather or soap/candle making)

  • Wellness professionals (e.g. meditation, yoga, breathwork, sound therapy, aromatherapy, gratitude practices, mindful eating)

You propose something else which may be suited? Feel free to still reach out!

  • You register to propose your services and set your own rates

  • Culture Vitale offers you a premium professional listing

  • We promote your services as part of our sessions

  • Clients can find and contact you directly

AN EXAMPLE:

Requirements

  • Expertise in either wellness, arts/artisanal, coaching
  • Based in Europe (preferably EU)
  • Fluent in your local language (eg. French, Polish, German), and conversational in English (100% fluency not essential)

  • Reliable, creative, and excited to share your craft with new audiences

  • Set your own rates (session-based or per-person)

raw.title: Inventory Specialist
raw.excerpt: Who You Are:You are a highly organized and detail-oriented inventory professional who has experience in all aspects of processing inventory-related transactions, preferably with high-growth, product-based companies.
raw.description:
Who You Are:

You are a highly organized and detail-oriented inventory professional who has experience in all aspects of processing inventory-related transactions, preferably with high-growth, product-based companies. You have a strong background in hands-on inventory control, are comfortable using various reporting platforms, and thrive in environments where structure is being built from the ground up. You are a strategic thinker who can identify solutions to issues while bringing solutions to fruition by working across the organization, collaborating with others, and ensuring execution through direct, hands-on involvement in any required change efforts.

The Task At Hand:

The Inventory Specialist reports to the Inventory Operations Manager, processing daily inventory transactions from various business partners and assisting with expediting the month-end close processes. This role possesses a strong understanding of how inventory transactions are processed. The incumbent must understand the financial impact of the transactions. The Inventory Specialist interacts effectively with all levels of management across all functional areas.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Assist with processing consumption and production of inventory for various co-manufacturers
  • Investigate and resolve variances discovered through the book-to-book process
  • Assist with analyzing usage variances for work orders
  • Help with closing work orders every week
  • Overseeing transactions for the co-manufacturer in the automation platform
  • Support month-end and year-end inventory reconciliation activities
  • Maintain accurate inventory reports and dashboards to support supply planning, procurement, and logistics teams
  • Collaborate with co-manufacturers to reconcile inventory data, confirm production usage
  • Assist with accounting policies and procedures and the effectiveness of internal controls
  • Support system implementations, where applicable
  • Supporting other activities, projects as assigned or dictated by business priorities

In This Role, You’ll Bring With You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related financial field is preferred
  • 3+ years of experience in inventory management or warehouse operations in a CPG or food-related environment
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with high attention to detail
  • Proactive and hands-on, with a problem-solving mindset and strong communication skills
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft Suite, Outlook, Slack, and other professional platforms
  • Organized and able to prioritize in accordance with company requirements and compliance standards
  • Capability to drill down and investigate, and determine opportunities to improve departmental efficiencies through process design and effective use of automation
  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and VLOOKUPs, required
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft Suite, Outlook, Slack, and other professional platforms
  • Up to 10% travel required: Although this role is a remote work-from-home position, we “Farmers” do meet as a company and/or as a department a few times a year. Anticipate possible travel up to a few times each quarter
  • Genuinely passionate about improving childhood nutrition for a healthier and happier planet
  • Desire to contribute to a dynamic, high-growth, purpose-driven work environment
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity, deeply understand business needs, develop a cohesive strategy, and make decisions requiring a high level of judgment
  • Previous exposure to cross-functional work between Sustainability and Finance preferred
  • Must reside in the United States to be considered for this position
  • Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position

Compensation:

  • Full-Time, Salaried, Exempt
  • The anticipated salary range for this position is $65,000.00 to $75,000.00. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a few factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses, stipends, equity, and role-specific perks.

Additional:

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Annual Bonus
  • 401(k) program + 4% company match after three months
  • New Hire Remote Life Stipend + annual Nourish and Nurture Allowance
  • Monthly Cell and Internet Stipend
  • Quarterly Farm-to-Fridge home deliveries and Employee Discounts
  • New Parents: Up to 18 weeks of paid Parental Leave, Baby Steps Back To Work, 3 months’ supply of Once Upon a Farm products, and breast milk shipping service and support for those who travel after birth for the duration of your breastfeeding journey
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Paid Volunteer Time
  • Paid Time Off to fulfill civic responsibilities, including jury duty and voting in local, state, and national elections
  • Medical Insurance for the employee is covered at 100% on select plans, with additional plan options at a reduced cost to the employee
  • Vision and Dental Insurance are covered at 100% for the employee and dependents
  • Life insurance
  • Flexible spending account (Medical & Dependent Care) and Health Savings Accounts for applicable plans
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • All other benefits, leaves, and insurance as required by law, based on your specific residence
  • And so much more!

Who We Are

Our Purpose: Drive systemic improvement in childhood nutrition for a healthier, happier, and more equitable world.

Our Business: At Once Upon a Farm, a better story starts here. We're on a greater mission in providing organic, crave-worthy snacks and meals for children of all ages. Our recipes are crafted with only the best organic ingredients – whole fruits and veggies, cold-pressed (our pouches), or freshly frozen (our meals) to perfection– to support your growing kids at every stage. Each of our organic, non-GMO, non-dairy recipes contains no added sugar and are free from artificial flavors, colors, and preservatives – just simple, real, nutritious snacks your entire family will love.

We support and champion farmers who supply the highest-quality organic ingredients for our foods. We help parents keep their promise to provide the best nourishment for their children’s bodies and souls. We treat our consumers, customers, suppliers, investors, and all our valued employees with the same high level of dignity and respect that we expect from others. We will always fight for and support efforts to drive positive social change and food justice for the benefit of parents, kids, and families. Lastly, we foster an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values humility, honesty, passion, positive social impact, and fun.

Our Team: We’re all fully remote, which makes us a highly collaborative, dynamic, and supportive bunch. We share a singular mission to make the world a better place through the highest quality, most delicious, nourishing, and nutritious products made accessible to every home, from our farms to your fridge. And while we’re invested in our product, we’re equally invested in one another's success.

Once Upon a Farm is a purpose-driven brand made up of an inclusive group of individuals with diverse backgrounds, passions, and beliefs. We hire self-motivated, independent thinkers, and those who are genuinely passionate about improving childhood nutrition for a healthier and happier planet. Bring your whole self to your work at Once Upon a Farm, a proud equal-opportunity employer. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use.

In an effort to help us remove unconscious bias from our resume review process, we ask that you please remove all identifying information from your resume (like profile photos) before you upload it. Once Upon a Farm is committed to cultivating an inclusive environment where a diverse group of people can and want to do their best work, and that starts with our hiring practices.

Once Upon a Farm, PBC, provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants in all company facilities without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental and/or intellectual disability, age, military status or status as a Vietnam-era or special disabled veteran, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition (including, but not limited to, cancer-related or HIV/AIDS-related), genetic information, or sexual orientation in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Please see our Privacy Policy to learn more about the data we collect.

This job description is a summary of duties; it is by no means an all-inclusive list but is merely a broad guide of expected duties.
