raw.title: Senior Go Engineer (Colibrix Partners)
raw.excerpt: At COLIBRIX ONE*, we're building advanced, AI-powered payment technologies that support Payment Service Providers (PSPs), Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), and neobanks across the EU and the UK.
raw.description:
At COLIBRIX ONE*, we're building advanced, AI-powered payment technologies that support Payment Service Providers (PSPs), Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), and neobanks across the EU and the UK. As a fully licensed Electronic Money Institution (FCA Reference No. 927920) and holder of a Financial Institution Licence issued by the MFSA, as well as a principal member of both VISA and Mastercard, we provide comprehensive, real-world financial solutions that include:

  • Global card processing
  • Digital wallet infrastructure
  • Cross-border merchant accounts
  • Alternative payment methods (APMs)
  • Corporate accounts for legal entities

We're a fast-growing team with a passion for innovation, security, and scalability. Our culture values curiosity, collaboration, and impact - and we're looking for talented professionals who are ready to shape the future of fintech.

At COLIBRIX ONE, your work directly powers the digital economy. If you're eager to solve meaningful challenges and build with purpose, we'd love to hear from you.

Tech stack:

Go, MongoDB, Redis, NATS, JetStream, REST/gRPC, AWS, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, ArgoCD, Prometheus, Grafana.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design and develop Go-based services for the Colibrix Partners card-issuing platform — card lifecycle (issuance, top-ups, blocks, replacement, expiry), wallets and balances, fees and commissions, authorisation and clearing flows — with a focus on stability, fault tolerance, and correct handling of financial operations
  • Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and propose concrete solutions at the service and module level, including API design, data models, and integrations with external providers
  • Build solutions in compliance with security requirements, including PCI DSS, proper handling of sensitive data, and secure inter-service communication

Company Overview:

At myKaarma, we’re not just leading the way in fixed ops solutions for the automotive industry—we’re redefining what’s possible for dealership service centers. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and powered by a global team, our industry-leading SaaS platform combines communication, scheduling, and payment tools in one seamless solution that keeps dealerships and vehicle owners connected. With myKaarma, every service interaction flows effortlessly, bringing good karma to customers and service teams.

Rooted in the principles of the Toyota Production System, we operate with precision, efficiency, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement to deliver a better experience for all. We’re looking for innovators, problem-solvers, and tech enthusiasts passionate about building solutions people love to use. If you’re ready to make an impact in an industry ripe for change, join us at myKaarma and help shape the future of automotive service.

At myKaarma, exceptional customer interactions are the cornerstone of our success. Our platform is meticulously engineered to communicate with customers at every aspect of the service, repair, and maintenance journey, ensuring positive and memorable experiences.

Role Description

As an Implementation Specialist at myKaarma, you will own the technical configuration and implementation readiness of our service scheduling, digital check-in, and vehicle inspection solutions. You will partner directly with automotive dealership customers to understand their service workflows, operational needs, existing technology, and integration dependencies—then translate those requirements into reliable, scalable solutions.

You will serve as a technical escalation resource throughout the implementation process, resolving complex configuration challenges, confirming infrastructure readiness, and testing the complete customer journey before training begins. Working closely with Deployment Managers and the Training Team, you will ensure each solution is fully configured and prepared for a successful launch. You will also develop documentation, templates, automations, and repeatable processes that improve implementation efficiency and create a consistent customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Guide automotive dealership customers through the setup of myKaarma’s service scheduling, digital check-in, and vehicle inspection tools, ensuring each solution is configured to support the dealership’s specific business needs.
  • Lead detailed discovery sessions to understand each dealership’s current workflows, operating processes, and existing technology, including any systems that myKaarma will replace.
  • Confirm that each assigned dealership has the required devices, network connectivity, and technical infrastructure in place well before implementation or onsite training begins.
  • Test and demonstrate the configured solution with the customer before training, walking through the full service experience from appointment scheduling and customer arrival through vehicle inspection and service completion.
  • Coordinate closely with the Deployment Manager and Training Team to communicate customer requirements, resolve configuration issues, and ensure each product is fully prepared for onsite or remote training.
  • Develop templates, automations, and repeatable processes that make product setup more efficient, reduce manual administrative work, and allow more time for meaningful customer consultation.

Qualifications and Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in software implementation, deployment, customer onboarding, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Experience working in automotive, Software as a Service (SaaS), or another technology-enabled service environment.
  • Strong communication and customer consultation skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear system requirements.
  • Self-directed and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Comfortable using business tools such as Salesforce and Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Forms, and related applications.
  • General understanding of software implementation processes and customer service best practices.

Preferred/Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience working in automotive dealership service operations, such as service scheduling, customer check-in, repair orders, or vehicle inspections.
  • Experience implementing or supporting software used by automotive dealerships.
  • Familiarity with myKaarma products or similar dealership technology platforms.

We know great candidates don't always match every requirement. If this role excites you and your experience aligns with many of the qualifications, we'd encourage you to apply. Skills can be learned—we also value curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to grow.

Total Rewards at myKaarma

At myKaarma, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that extends beyond the base salary. Our commitment to competitive compensation includes bonuses and benefits that support both personal and professional well-being:

  • Flexible Work Environment: We embrace a high-performance, flexible structure that values freedom and responsibility. Our “Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled” model empowers teams to innovate and continuously improve using data-driven insights.
  • Health and Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits, along with wellness and telework stipends.
  • Time Off: Generous vacation time to recharge and balance life outside work.
  • In-Office Perks: Enjoy dog-friendly offices and unlimited snacks or refreshments onsite.

The starting salary range for this role is $69,135.00 - $86,419.00 USD per year, depending on experience and qualifications, reflecting our dedication to competitive industry compensation. Additional details about our Total Rewards package will be shared during recruitment.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At myKaarma, diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and inclusive workplace where every employee feels valued and empowered and can do meaningful work. Our mission to deliver exceptional solutions to our clients is strengthened by the unique contributions and perspectives of our team members from all backgrounds.

As an equal opportunity employer, myKaarma prohibits any form of unlawful discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable laws in the regions where we operate. We adhere to all EEOC regulations and actively promote an environment that celebrates and supports diversity, equity, and inclusion for all.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. Reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done, which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on myKaarma. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process by filling out this form.

myKaarma participates in the E-Verify Program.
myKaarma considers candidates requiring work authorization on a case-by-case basis. Sponsorship may be available for exceptional candidates depending on role requirements and business need

Work Summary

DataForce is seeking a motivated Scheduler to work remotely to schedule recording sessions for one of our Data Collection projects taking place in Bergen, Norway. As our Scheduler, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our project runs smoothly, appointments with project participants are efficiently scheduled and managed, and deadlines are met.

Schedulers are responsible for communicating with potential participants via phone or email, as well as screening them based on defined criteria, and scheduling them based on their availability. Schedulers are also responsible for responding to pre-study participant questions, and pre-study follow-ups to encourage attendance and minimize no shows. The remote scheduler is the first point of contact between our team and study participants.

  • Answering candidates' questions

  • Providing logistic information

  • Scheduling candidate for the sessions time

  • Filling the session schedule days in advance

  • Communicating daily schedule updates to project team

  • Idiomatic fluency in Norwegian Nynorsk

  • Can adapt to the CET time zone

  • Be able to work a flexible schedule as needed

  • Have computer competency for data entry and the production of reports and schedules

  • Be able to adapt to changing priorities through applied feedback, and shifting focus quickly as project needs evolve

  • Must possess outstanding customer service, excellent communication skills including phone, email, and electronic media communication

  • Must be extremely detail-oriented

  • Experience working in a team

DataForce by TransPerfect is part of the TransPerfect family of companies, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business, with offices in more than 100 cities worldwide.

Garantizar la entrega de interfaces web de alto rendimiento, escalables y accesibles, transformando requerimientos de UX/UI en experiencias digitales fluidas mientras se eleva el estándar técnico del equipo mediante buenas prácticas y herramientas asistidas por IA.

  • Experiencia con Microfrontends o Module Federation.

raw.description:
The Role

Wpromote is looking for a relationship-driven, highly strategic Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager to help grow and activate our ecosystem of media, technology, measurement, AI, and emerging-platform partners.

Reporting into the Vice President, Media Investment, this role will own a portfolio of strategic partner relationships while helping Wpromote identify new capabilities, create joint opportunities, educate internal teams, and bring differentiated solutions to our clients.

You’ll work across Product, Data & Analytics, Earned Media, Client Strategy, Media, Marketing, and Events to ensure Wpromote is getting more than access from our partnerships - we’re turning them into meaningful capabilities, client opportunities, thought leadership, and competitive advantage.

The ideal candidate is a strong relationship manager who can also operate. You’re excited to discover emerging technology partners, evaluate where they fit within Wpromote’s offering, connect them with the right internal stakeholders, create enablement plans, and build repeatable partnership motions that generate meaningful client and business opportunities. You’ll also make Wpromote’s partner ecosystem easier for teams to navigate and activate.

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Flexible schedules

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)
-Work from anywhere options*
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching
-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
-Sponsored life insurance
-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass Credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $110,000 - $130,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above.

*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams
Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

You Will Be

    Partner Management

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with assigned media, technology, measurement, and emerging-platform partners.

  • Own a portfolio of Media and Technology Partnerships.

  • Develop strong relationships with partner teams and ensure Wpromote has access to relevant strategic and commercial opportunities.

  • Create clear relationship plans for priority partners, including objectives, internal stakeholders, opportunities, and next steps.

  • Maintain Wpromote’s partner matrix and opportunity pipeline.

    • Building Wpromote’s Emerging Partner Ecosystem

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop relationships with partners across areas such as:

  • Retail Media and Commerce

  • AI and AI Search

  • Audience and Identity

  • Measurement and Incrementality

  • Creator Marketing

  • Email and SMS

  • Brand Safety

  • Media Automation

  • Media

  • Emerging advertising and marketing technologies

  • Help determine which partners should become strategic relationships versus tactical solutions and negotiate commercial agreements

  • Work with Product and internal subject-matter experts to evaluate new capabilities and determine where they fit within Wpromote’s offering.

  • Bring new solutions and opportunities to internal teams before they become table stakes in the market.

    • Internal Enablement

  • Develop and distribute partnership communications, updates, and enablement materials.

  • Maintain Wpromote’s internal partner directory, resource hub, and partnership materials.

  • Introduce internal teams to strategic partners and emerging capabilities.

  • Coordinate partner trainings, certifications, demonstrations, and educational sessions.

  • Partner closely with Client Strategy and Media teams to help them identify when and how to bring partner capabilities to clients.

  • Build AI processes that make it easy for teams to discover, understand, and activate Wpromote’s partner ecosystem.

    • Co-Marketing and Events

  • Partner with Marketing and Events to develop and execute co-marketing programs with strategic partners, including thought leadership, research, content, awards, and industry events.

  • Identify and coordinate opportunities for Wpromote leaders, subject-matter experts, clients, and teams to participate in partner content, events, and industry conversations.

  • Manage partner-facing content and visibility, including case studies, awards submissions, website updates, profiles, and joint thought leadership.

  • Own recurring internal partnership communications, including newsletters, Slack updates, event calendars, and other programming, while coordinating partner-related logistics with Marketing and Events.

You Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, media, ad tech, martech, digital marketing, or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge of the advertising and marketing technology ecosystem.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with multiple external partners simultaneously.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Strong project-management and organizational skills.

  • Ability to understand technical or complex products and translate them into clear client and business applications.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally across Product, Media, Data & Analytics, Client Strategy, Marketing, and senior leadership.

  • Ability to identify opportunities proactively rather than waiting for partner requests.

  • Strong presentation and internal enablement skills.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, emerging platforms, and the future of marketing technology.

Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. raw.description:
Eversheds Sutherland's US Innovation Team is seeking an experienced AI Application Developer to drive the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions across the firm. In this role, you will be the technical authority on all things AI — from architecting enterprise-grade machine learning systems to building intelligent agents that transform how our lawyers and business professionals work. You will collaborate closely with attorneys, business stakeholders, and IT to translate complex legal and operational needs into scalable, secure, and elegant technology solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties:

AI Solution Architecture & Development

  • Lead end-to-end development of AI-powered applications, including large language model (LLM) integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous agent frameworks.
  • Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to enable interoperability between AI agents and firm systems.
  • Architect solutions on Azure AI Foundry, ensuring alignment with enterprise security, compliance, and scalability requirements.
  • Develop and maintain AI workflows using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps, and AI Builder, to extend AI capabilities to non-technical users across the firm.
  • Build and optimize SQL-based data layers to support AI applications, reporting, and analytics pipelines.

Technical Leadership & Best Practices

  • Establish and champion coding standards, code review processes, and documentation practices for the innovation team.
  • Define and implement DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for AI and software projects, ensuring reliable deployment, monitoring, and rollback capabilities.
  • Recommend and maintain version control strategies using Git, with branching models appropriate for collaborative legal technology development.
  • Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, tools, and methodologies and provide recommendations for adoption where appropriate.

Firm-Wide Scalability & Governance

raw.description:
Why join Upscale, Inc.

Upscale, Inc., is building the high-performance infrastructure powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. Backed by over $300M in funding and rapid global adoption, we are scaling systems designed for the world’s most demanding AI workloads.

We focus on first-principles engineering across silicon, systems, and networking—where performance, scale, and execution are critical. Our team is talent-dense and high-performing. We value ownership, technical rigor, and speed, and we offer the opportunity to work on foundational problems with immediate, real-world impact.

If you’re looking to do high-impact work, move fast, and help define the infrastructure behind the future of AI—Upscale is where you can produce meaningful work at the frontier—and operate at a high standard.

About the job

The Senior Test Manager is responsible for building and maintaining a motivated and capable team, establishing an effective and consistent approach to the delivery of Test Management.

Responsible for leading the delivery of test management to multiple CQC technology products and IT projects, working with other teams to proactively manage dependencies, overcome obstacles and get the best value against constraints.

The Senior Test Manager oversees the testing process of products or systems to ensure they meet quality standards before release. This position involves overseeing an organization's testing framework, policy, processes and teams, requiring a strategic mindset and technical expertise.

Upscale AI’s SOCs are the most advanced in the world. In this role, you will help to manufacture the SoC’s that power these data centers by developing and deploying comprehensive manufacturing test and data analytics solutions for high-volume manufacturing at wafer fabrications and Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Tests (OSAT’s).

You will have an opportunity to create silicon in the most advanced technologies and follow it into the field to close the loop back to design and test for the next-generation of chips. You will help to integrate SoC technologies into devices and drive manufacturing test flows to assure performance and screen devices.

You will drive yield improvement, cost optimization and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the optimal test coverage in production to ensure high quality SoCs. You will need to have a strong understanding of Integrated Circuit (IC) flows, wafer processing, testing, qualification, diagnostics, and failure analysis.

You will work with various groups to deploy screening methodologies and flows for data processing, analytics and diagnostics. You will drive the release of cost-effective production test solutions into mass production to hit yield and quality goals.

Responsibilities

    • Develop and implement high-volume manufacturing strategies for SoC products, optimize ATE/SLT test coverage, reduce Defective parts per million (DPPM) and test costs, and manage product data integration.
    • Accelerate mass production via test program releases, data analytics, lot disposition, test time reduction, yield improvement, and return merchandise authorization (RMA) handling.
    • Partner with cross-functional teams (Test, Quality, Packaging, Operations) to deploy and maintain high-volume manufacturing (HVM) screening solutions.
    • Manage database integration for wafer sort (CP), final test, and SLT, while overseeing test program integration, production release, binning, manufacturing flow definition, NPI material handling, and foundry process optimization.

Preferred qualifications

    • Experience with industry standards, design tools, and design for testing (DFT) best practices, including at-speed transition delay fault (TDF), automatic test pattern generation (ATPG), memory built-in self-test (MBIST), memory repair, diagnostic tools, and yield improvement.
    • Experience with product engineering, supply chain data analytics and diagnostics for High Volume Manufacturing and NPI.
    • Experience evaluating customer returns with ATE and SLT, identifying coverage gaps, developing incremental structural and functional patterns to address quality issues, Statistical analysis (e.g., JMP), Yield Management Systems (e.g., Exensio, YieldExplorer, JMP), and Python for data analytics.
    • Understanding of skew lot definition, data collection, characterization, data analysis and report.
    • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 12 years of experience in product engineering or test engineering.
    • 3 years of experience in people management, developing employees.
    • Experience with product engineering, supply chain data analytics or diagnostics for manufacturing or New Product Introduction (NPI).

Where you fall within that range depends on your experience, skills, and impact—we benchmark against internal levels to keep things fair and consistent.

Equal Opportunity

Upscale, Inc., is building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.

Accessibility & Accommodations

We’re committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need accommodations at any stage, just reach out to us at —we’re happy to help. Note: This inbox is only for accommodation requests.

About Motum

Motum connects experienced developers, engineers, and technical professionals with US companies building committed, long-term tech teams.

Our roles are fully remote and full-time, designed for people who want real ownership, meaningful work, and the opportunity to grow inside US-based dynamic teams.

When you join Motum, you work full-time with one company, integrate directly into their team, and build a career with long-term impact. Ready to join us?

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager / IT Manager to lead and coordinate a small but highly capable technical team working across multiple AI-driven products. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, operations, and stakeholders, with a strong focus on execution, planning, and team enablement, rather than hands-on coding.

The team is technically strong and largely self-sufficient, but currently lacks structured planning, backlog management, sprint discipline, and cross-functional coordination. This role exists to bring order, clarity, and predictability to how work is planned and delivered—without disrupting a healthy team dynamic.

The person in this role will act as a front-line technical manager and Scrum-style leader, responsible for organizing work, managing priorities, guiding agile processes, and helping the team operate efficiently across multiple concurrent products and customer projects. While this role does not require active development work, it does require a solid technical foundation to understand the architecture, challenges, and translate business needs into executable technical plans.

The environment includes AI agents, LLM-based systems, documentprocessing, backendpipelines, cloudinfrastructure, and containerizedservices. The ideal candidate understands these concepts well enough to ask the right questions, guide architectural thinking, and prevent short-term decisions from creating long-term technical or cost issues.

This role also involves people leadership at a small scale—coaching engineers, setting expectations, addressing blockers, and helping team members balance delivery work with professional growth. As the organization grows, this role is expected to mature into a stronger people and delivery leadership position.

Responsibilities

    • Own day-to-day coordination and task management for the technical team across multiple products and initiatives
    • Act as a Scrum Master–style leader, facilitating sprint planning, backlog grooming, standups, and delivery forecasting
    • Work closely with Product and Business stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-defined technical tasks and user stories
    • Improve and enforce agile discipline, including capacity planning, velocity tracking, backlog prioritization, and multi-sprint planning
    • Ensure the team is focused on the right work at the right time, helping unblock issues and redirect effort when priorities shift
    • Guide technical discussions at a conceptual and architectural level, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, and aligned with long-term goals
    • Participate in customer and stakeholder meetings to help ask the right technical questions and validate feasibility early
    • Coordinate cross-functional inputs from Product, Security, QA, and Infrastructure teams
    • Monitor infrastructure usage and operational costs, identifying inefficiencies and preventing unnecessary spend
    • Help manage technical risk, including SOC 2 and security-related work, without derailing delivery commitments
    • Support engineers through coaching, feedback, and light people management, including time management and professional development guidance
    • Assess team capacity and make hiring or resourcing recommendations based on demand and workload
    • Maintain a collaborative team culture by listening first, understanding historical decisions, and introducing improvements thoughtfully

Requirements

    • Experience in a technical leadership, delivery manageror technical product manager role
    • Strong understanding of agile methodologies, with real-world experience in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and capacity management
    • Solid technical foundation in backend systems, distributed architectures, and system integration
    • Familiarity with AI/LLM concepts, including prompts, model usage, data pipelines, and architectural considerations (hands-on experience not required)
    • Exposure to cloud infrastructure, containers, and resource management (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes concepts)
    • Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, product leaders, and non-technical stakeholders
    • Prior experience coordinating or managing engineers, even in a small or informal capacity
    • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing demands across multiple products
    • Cost-conscious mindset when evaluating technical and infrastructure decisions
    • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment with incomplete information
    • Willingness to learn continuously and ask questions when encountering unfamiliar technical areas
    • Collaborative leadership style focused on guidance, alignment, and enablement, not command-and-control

  • Full-Time: 40 hours per week

raw.title: Mid-Level Full Stack Engineer
raw.excerpt: ⚡ About AmberAmber is an entirely new way of thinking about buying, banking and selling energy where home energy technology works to put money back in customers’ pockets and accelerate the renewable energy transition.
raw.description:
⚡ About Amber

Amber is an entirely new way of thinking about buying, banking and selling energy where home energy technology works to put money back in customers’ pockets and accelerate the renewable energy transition.

We’re an Australian headquartered company, where we are both an energy technology company and a utility providing energy directly to households and small businesses. In Australia (the world leader on rooftop solar and a 2-way energy grid), we’ve proven that the cheapest, fastest and most rewarding way to reach 100% renewables is to automate the growing wave of home batteries, EVs, and other smart energy devices.

Customers get direct access to the real-time electricity prices and the technology to shift energy usage to the times when cheaper renewables are available in the grid and export to the grid at times when the price they can be paid for it is highest.

We are a clear market leader in energy automation in Australia, and are now partnering with utilities across Europe to bring our technology to European markets and consumers.

We’re at a critical moment in taking the business to scale in Europe. You’ll be joining a rapidly growing regional team of 25, and be part of a global team of over 240, with expertise across energy, technology, marketing, and operations. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and a great culture of people who love coming to work to build a better world.

We’re backed by leading VCs in Australia and Europe, as well as impact-focused investors and world-leading energy companies.

💻 About the role

Want to help improve the environment by shifting the world’s energy usage towards renewables?

We are currently hiring for a mid-level Full Stack Software Engineer. Amber provides a great opportunity to apply your skills as an Engineer to help enable the uptake of renewable energy. Our technology optimises thousands of batteries and other devices in the customers' homes, enabling them to time their usage to consume power at times of high renewable penetration (and cheap prices), and then export power back to the grid at critical times - letting them outbid energy generators and earn potentially >£50 in an afternoon.

At Amber, we believe that enabling a culture where everyone is set up to do the best work of their lives, and feels connected and supported, is one of the most important things we can do to ensure our long-term success.

The Amber Electric product team develops and supports:

  • Home automation integrations (to batteries, solar systems, and EVs) that control electricity usage in response to pricing and renewable availability
  • Mobile & Web apps for customers to monitor and manage their energy usage
  • A pricing and billing engine for real time energy pricing

The European team adapts and expands these systems to local energy markets across the UK and Europe, getting them to the customers of our partner utilities.

The tech stack is React Native mobile app, some React web frontends, and a Serverless Lambda backend on AWS. We’re using Typescript top to bottom, and Apollo GraphQL sits in the middle. We keep our data in DynamoDB, Postgres, and Snowflake, using one or the other as best suits a particular workload.

You can learn more about our tech stack at

While we’re looking for talented and driven individuals our desire is to build a champion team, not a team of champions. We’re full-stack-ish; while it’s impossible for everyone to excel across every layer of the stack we value people who can chip in wherever they’re needed. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace from the ground up. We want engineers who are as comfortable communicating with people as they are with their code.

🛠️ Qualifications and Skills

At Amber, we want to hire self-starters who are eager to learn, and are comfortable working in a changing environment. Some of the key traits we are looking for in this role:

  • You have a positive mindset: equal parts collaborative, curious, and can-do
  • Between 3 and 5 years of commercial development experience
  • Commercial experience with the specific technologies in our stack is a strong plus
  • Commercial experience with Typescript is preferred, though languages sharing similar features (such as JavaScript, C#, Go) are also acceptable
  • We favour generalists with strong backend skills, who are open to flexing across the stack (front end, back end, infrastructure)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills built on a foundation of empathy for your fellow humans is essential, with English proficiency of C1/C2 level at a minimum.

👉🏽 Your Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain high quality program code across the stack
  • Work collaboratively within the product team, taking a high degree of ownership not just of the code you write but of the product that makes it to end users and the processes we employ to get it there
  • Contribute your knowledge to the wider Amber org through RFCs, shares and active engagement in shared discussions
  • Research, consult, and evaluate our system requirements to identify and discuss appropriate iterations and tradeoffs to meet our goals
  • Test, debug, diagnose, and correct errors in our tech stack according to our operational specifications
  • Support the apps that are live with our partners, ensuring their customers have a great experience
  • Work directly with external partners while collaborating across internal teams, including leadership, product, design, engineering, and customer operations to deliver impactful solutions.

🎉 Benefits

  • We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and a great culture of people who love coming to work to build a better world
  • Join a growing technology start-up that will shape the future of household renewable energy use
  • You’d be a part of a growing team of over 240 people with expertise across energy, technology, marketing, and operations
  • Flexible working hours & remote working - see "How You Work" for more info
  • Competitive salary within your local market
  • Share options in Amber Electric
  • Employment and leave entitlements as per your local country
  • An external Employee Assistance Plan for mental health support
  • Annual Learning & Development budget to support your personal growth
  • Annual company conference in Melbourne, Australia.

💰 Salary range

Between £45,000 and £70,000 base per annum. All roles at Amber include employee stock options.

The salary for this role is benchmarked to London, UK, with a location-based adjustment reflecting cost, tax and collaboration factors across Europe. You're free to work from any of our preferred locations in Europe - pay simply reflects where you're based.

This is a full-time role to be based from the UK/Germany/Netherlands. We have an office space in London for those based there.

🇬🇧How You Work🇦🇺

You will be working almost entirely remotely within a high-trust environment where transparency and accountability are foundational to our engineering culture. Amber's flexible approach allows you to shape your schedule around core collaboration hours, which are 7am - 12pm Tuesdays and Thursdays London time. This overlap enables meaningful collaboration with your Australian colleagues.

Outside these core hours, we trust you to manage your time effectively. We expect consistent communication and reliable delivery with a focus on outcomes and impact. Proactive check-ins and sharing progress updates transparently are part of how we maintain this balance of flexibility and responsibility.

We value work-life balance and sustainable pace—we don't want team members to overwork or burn out, nor do we expect you to be available 24/7. Instead, we promote clear boundaries and open dialogue about workload and capacity.

Our headquarters is located in Melbourne, Australia. Our European team operates from a central London hub that you will travel to during your onboarding, and approximately every 2 months thereafter for team collaboration. These in-person sessions help strengthen relationships and reinforce our collaborative culture.

We also have AmberCon every year, this is a big team calendar event and we will fly you to Melbourne to be there with the rest of the team. We will always cover flights, accommodation and other travel costs as part of our travel policies.

🌈 If this kind of work gets you excited, we'd love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements listed above, we still encourage you to apply. We're open to all backgrounds and encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

🪄 How to Apply

Please include your resume and a cover letter telling us one specific way you could use your technical skills to improve a household's energy use under the Amber model.

Humans will read this cover letter, so we will notice and appreciate if a human has written it!

Our process will generally be as follows:

  • A screening interview with our talent team
  • A take-home technical challenge that should take no longer than four hours
  • A follow up interview with two members of the engineering team
  • A culture interview with two members of the engineering leadership team

We promise to be respectful of your time as an applicant while trying to be as thorough as possible in finding the right fit for our team.

Only applicants with full working rights in the role’s location will be considered.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted promptly. All other applicants will also be notified of the outcome as soon as possible.

No recruitment agencies please. We are already working with our preferred partners. Thank you!

raw.excerpt: 🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated.
raw.description:
🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands and launching very soon in Luxembourg and Austria. Backed by 17 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we’re building a brand new, proudly European payment system. Why not join us?

🔎 What's in it for you

Play a key role in protecting Europe’s next-generation payment infrastructure. As an Operations Security Engineer, you will be at the heart of EPI’s Security Operations capability: triaging alerts, responding to incidents, improving detection coverage and proactively hunting for threats across cloud, identity, endpoint and application environments.

This is a high-impact opportunity to combine hands-on SOC expertise, threat hunting and detection engineering in a remote-first, pan-European company where security directly supports the resilience and trust of Wero.

🐝 About the team

You’ll join the Security Operations team within Operations Services Delivery. The team brings together highly skilled security profiles, including SOC, IAM, general security, threat hunting and penetration testing expertise.

You’ll collaborate closely with Security, Engineering, DevOps, IT and Operations teams to strengthen detection and response capabilities, improve tooling and ensure strong visibility across our environments. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on investigation, structured incident response and clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

💥Your impact

  • Act as a central point of contact for alert triage, incident identification and security event investigation across EPI environments.

  • Execute incident response activities using structured frameworks such as SANS PICERL, from preparation and identification through containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.

  • Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts based on attacker behaviour, emerging threats, threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

  • Parse, analyse and correlate logs from authentication, application, system, endpoint and cloud telemetry sources, including AWS and Azure.

  • Design, tune and maintain detection rules, use cases, dashboards, custom alerts and automation workflows to identify anomalies, lateral movement and persistent threats.

  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of SOC playbooks, runbooks, SIEM and EDR integrations.

  • Document and communicate threat findings, incident outcomes and remediation recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with engineering, SOC, IR and IT teams to improve detection coverage, response readiness and operational resilience.

💻 Technology stack & way of working

  • Primary security tools: Rapid7, Microsoft Defender, SIEM and EDR technologies

  • Cloud, identity & operations: AWS, Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, PagerDuty

  • Scripting, querying & automation: Python, PowerShell, KQL, custom alerting and auto-remediation workflows

  • Collaboration & delivery: Jira, Confluence, GitHub

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

  • +8 years of experience in cybersecurity, with strong hands-on experience as a SOC analyst, incident responder, detection engineer or similar role.

  • Fluent in English (CEFR C1 or C2); French, German, Dutch or other European languages are a plus.

  • Thrive in a remote-first, multicultural and fast-paced environment.

  • Strong familiarity with the full SOC lifecycle, from Tier 1 to Tier 3, including alert triage, incident response, threat hunting and threat intelligence.

  • Proven experience in threat hunting, detection engineering or threat intelligence, with the ability to turn attacker behaviours into actionable detections.

  • Solid understanding of SIEM and EDR technologies, log parsing, detection engineering and alert tuning.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting and querying tools such as Python, PowerShell or KQL to support automation, investigations and custom alerting.

  • Ability to analyse and correlate logs from diverse sources, including authentication, application, system and cloud telemetry across AWS and Azure.

  • Knowledge of attacker TTPs, MITRE ATT&CK, threat exposure and attack path analysis.

  • Experience creating or improving incident response playbooks, runbooks and automation workflows.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and security risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation, approximately one week per month, to support incident response and operational continuity.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with Rapid7 and with TaHiTI.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID and its integration into detection and response workflows.

  • Nice-to-have certifications such as GSEC, GCIH, BTL1/2, SC-200 or AZ-500.

  • Experience in payments, banking, fintech or another highly regulated environment.

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  1. A first call with one of our recruiters

  2. A technical interview with our CISO and a security expert

  3. A final interview with our COO

  4. Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You prefer a purely reactive SOC role where you only handle out-of-the-box alerts and escalations.

  • You don’t enjoy digging into logs, building queries, tuning detections or investigating ambiguous signals across distributed systems.

  • You are looking for a role with no on-call responsibilities or no operational incident response exposure.

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with engineering, DevOps, IT and business stakeholders.

🎁 What we can offer

  • Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups to keep teams connected and collaborative

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year

  • Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits programme

  • The opportunity to be part of a true pan-European company

  • Learning & development budget: €5,000 training budget per year

Otherwise apply!

🫶 Our commitment to equal employment opportunities

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.

  • Deliver WOW

  • Be Responsible in your actions

  • Pursue Growth & Learning

  • Be passionate and determined

  • Share your Power, Knowledge & Wealth

  • Build Authentic relationships

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

📌 More info about culture here in our Culture Book.

YOUR ROLE

Reporting to the Field Marketing Manager Team Lead, you will lead the US marketing strategy, defining and executing high-impact initiatives that drive awareness, credibility and lead generation. You will define the most efficient go-to-market (GTM) strategy for the US market spanning paid media, KOLs, content and other acquisition channels while working closely with the sales team to define market opportunities, create the right marketing materials and ensure effective communication and engagement with potential customers.

This is a senior role that stays close to execution: you will set positioning, messaging and strategic direction while remaining hands-on across content, PR, partnerships, events, sales enablement and digital marketing to position Kolsquare as a leader in the US market against already established US competitors.

Your key responsibilities :

GTM Strategy, Positioning & Sales Enablement

  • Define and execute the most efficient GTM strategy for the US market, including ads, content, PR and other acquisition channels.

  • Own positioning and messaging for the US market, building the initial GTM case study covering market entry approach, positioning, and messaging.

  • Build sales enablement assets and equip the sales team with the positioning, messaging, and communications tools they need to convert leads.

  • Take a 360° view of digital marketing: paid, organic, content, and email to build a cohesive, full-funnel US strategy.

Brand Awareness & Thought Leadership

  • Position Kolsquare as the go-to Influencer Marketing platform in the US through PR, localized thought leadership content, strategic partnerships, and events.

  • Build relationships with media, industry experts, and associations to amplify our thought leadership.

  • Working with the central content team, localize blog posts, reports, and whitepapers that showcase Kolsquare's expertise and proprietary data for the US audience.

  • Secure speaking engagements & media opportunities to strengthen brand authority.

Lead Generation & Sales Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales to define a local acquisition strategy that aligns with our business objectives.

  • Working with central product marketing and content marketing teams, localize marketing and sales enablement materials (brochures, case studies, blog articles, whitepapers, website, email sequences) that help the sales team convert leads.

  • Implement localized lead generation campaigns, including content marketing, paid media, and events.

  • Track key KPIs to measure impact and optimize campaigns for lead conversion.

  • Proactively collect, understand, and analyze feedback from local teams to propose and deliver the sales tools they need and feed back into product marketing

Events, Partnerships & Community Engagement

  • Identify, plan, and execute high-impact local events that generate brand visibility and qualified leads.

  • Develop strategic partnerships with marketing associations, agencies, and key industry players.

  • Engage with influencer marketing communities & ambassadors to create advocacy and strengthen Kolsquare's reputation.

Public Relations & Media Management

  • Manage local PR initiatives in collaboration with local PR agencies and journalists.

  • Pitch and distribute newsworthy content to key media outlets.

  • Monitor and analyze market trends & competitors, ensuring we stay ahead of industry changes.

YOUR PROFILE

Must-haves 🫵

  • You have 8+ years of senior-level experience in marketing or brand management, ideally in Influencer Marketing or SaaS Martech.

  • You're a strategic thinker and hands-on executor, ready to own and scale Kolsquare's presence in the US, senior enough to set direction, hands-on enough to execute it yourself.

  • You have a deep understanding of the US influencer marketing & media landscape, with an existing network.

  • You have strong experience in positioning, communications and sales enablement.

  • You've defined and run GTM strategies before through ads, content, and other acquisition channels and know how to pick the most efficient mix for a market.

  • You bring a 360° view of digital marketing, comfortable across paid, organic, content, and email.

  • You have a strong network with relevant US media, influencers and agencies.

  • You're commercially driven and know how to generate demand & support sales.

  • You have experience creating appealing marketing and sales enablement materials (case studies, reports, brochures, email sequences…).

  • A self-starter, you thrive in a fast-moving, international environment and demonstrate flexibility and proactivity.

  • You have experience organizing external and owned events.

  • You are comfortable and confident with public speaking at events and webinars.

  • You have strong collaborative skills.

  • Comfortable working remotely with the main team being in Europe and yourself based on the East Coast of the US.

We believe diverse backgrounds and experiences make our teams stronger. If you have the core skills and relevant experience for this role but don’t tick every box, don’t rule yourself out — we’d love to hear from you.
What matters most is what you can bring to the role and the impact you can make.

WHAT WE OFFER?

  • Salary range: $100K–$150K gross OTE annually

  • Full flexibility: Fully remote, with the option to work from anywhere on the US East Coast

  • 401(k): 2% employer match

  • PTO: 20 days per year

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

raw.description:
Aboutthe Firm

Eversheds Sutherland (US) LLP is part of a global law practice providing legal services to a broad range of clients, from small and mid‑sized businesses to the world’s leading multinational organizations. The firm combines deep local knowledge with global reach, supporting clients across industries and jurisdictions. Eversheds Sutherland is recognized for its collaborative culture, commitment to client service, and delivery of practical, commercially informed legal solutions.

Position Summary

A Business Technology Advisor works closely with the Director of Innovation and the firm's business services groups, providing support for a variety of operational applications and processes. This role is crucial in ensuring that our business professionals have the right tools and processes to perform their work efficiently and effectively. A Business Technology Advisor will have a combination of strong technical skills, a consulting approach, and excellent coaching skills.

A Business Technology Advisor is critical to ongoing experimentation, evaluation, and scaled adoption of emerging technologies, including generative AI, automation (Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Claude), and workflow redesign across the firm's operational functions.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Technology Assessment and Support

  • Collaborate with business services groups to understand their needs and identify the right technology solutions to enhance operational service delivery.
  • Evaluates, implements, and adopts operational and cross-functional solutions - including Power Automate flows, Copilot Studio agents, and Dataverse-backed applications - to improve efficiency and productivity. Maintains an awareness of emerging tools and technologies.
  • Monitors and analyzes the effectiveness of implemented technology solutions and makes necessary adjustments.
  • Provides training and coaching for business professionals on new technologies and processes.

AI Experimentation and Solution Design

  • Works with business teams to identify use cases/tasks where AI and automation can be used to improve work quality and speed.
  • Applies appropriate level of experimentation to use cases to ensure the best results; documents the differences in prompts, workflows, flows, and agents.
  • Shares outcomes with business teams and provides training and support as needed.

Process Analysis and Solution Build

  • Sits with business teams to map current workflows and identify where manual effort, duplication, or delay can be removed before reaching for a tool.
  • Designs and, in many cases, builds the solution directly, including Power Automate flows, Copilot Studio agents, Dataverse-backed apps, and M365 Copilot (or Claude) prompts and agents.
  • Maintains a library of proven flows, agents, and templates so solutions built for one business function can be redeployed for another rather than rebuilt from scratch.

Adoption, Enablement & Change Management

  • Designs and supports adoption programs, including onboarding plans, training exercises, communications, and post-implementation support.
  • Monitors usage analytics and determines appropriate ongoing awareness campaigns and training. Contributes to the "featured technology" program and attends relevant Innovation working group sessions.
  • Identifies opportunities to operationalize technology-assisted workflows (whether GenAI, Power Platform, or otherwise) and collaborates with key stakeholders, including role redesign where appropriate, to increase adoption.
  • Fosters a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the firm's business services functions.

Governance and Collaboration

  • Ensures that everything built follows the firm's data security, retention, and AI governance standards, working closely with Information Technology, Information Security, and Risk.
  • Works well with colleagues throughout the firm, but particularly with the Information Technology, Training, and Legal Technology Advisor teams, given shared tools, platforms, and standards.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 5-7 years of relevant work experience.
  • Project or product management experience.
  • Strong understanding of back-office and operational workflows across functions such as Accounting/Finance, HR, Marketing/BD, Practice Management, and IT.
  • Working fluency with Microsoft 365 (Copilot, Teams, SharePoint) and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Copilot Studio); working knowledge of data concepts and integration as a backbone for governed solutions.
  • Strong understanding of, and work with Claude as it relates to both individual and departmental use.
  • General automation literacy - enough understanding of APIs, integrations, and basic scripting to have credible conversations with IT and vendors, and to know when a problem needs a developer versus a citizen-development solution.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI infrastructure, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and similar frameworks that connect AI agents to firm systems, is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong intellectual curiosity and a lifelong learner mindset.
  • Ability to work effectively in a virtual/hybrid team environment.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to present ideas in a business-friendly and user-friendly language.
  • Discretion in working with confidential data.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in professional services, a law firm business services function, or a similar operational environment preferred.
  • Certification or coursework in AI, process improvement (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), Change Management, or related technologies preferred.

Education

  • A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is required.
  • An advanced degree or relevant certification (e.g., process improvement, project management, AI technology) is a plus but not required.

This is a remote role and the salary ranges for this position vary depending on the geographic location and other factors such as experience, internal equity, market data, and job-related considerations. The range for this position is from $110,00 - $135,000, with offers contingent upon the various factors. The firm’s compensation strategy includes not just a base salary but also comprehensive benefits such as healthcare, paid time off, discretionary merit bonuses, life and disability insurance, retirement plans and tailored learning opportunities.

Eversheds Sutherland (US) LLP is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion within our Firm and in the larger legal profession. We believe that diverse skills, knowledge and viewpoints make us a stronger firm. Eversheds Sutherland (US) LLP maintains a policy of affording all employees and applicants equal employment opportunities without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity, gender expression or being transgender), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, domestic violence victim status, ancestry, amnesty, citizenship status, ethnicity, military and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Unlawful discrimination, harassment and retaliation will not be tolerated in any of the Firm’s offices or any other work-related setting. Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation in order to apply for a position or to enable them to perform the essential functions of a position for which they are otherwise qualified. raw.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is looking for a dynamic individual to support our clinical team with scheduling & attendance, data collection, technology issues, and project based tasks. This candidate will play a critical role in maintaining the efficiency of our clinical team to deliver the best possible care to our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Open groups and ensure technical setup for day's expected clients
  • Virtual interaction with clients -- welcoming them to group, answering questions
  • Facilitates client and group facilitator virtual entry during treatment session
  • Monitors group attendance and helps to contact any absent clients
  • Verifies and publishes group attendance for all days and times of treatment
  • Effectively communicates client absences, technological difficulties, or clinical concerns with relevant team members, clients, and families
  • Provides clients and families with calendar invitations and text reminders to treatment sessions
  • Track and monitor alumni or family groups as needed
  • Administer surveys
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • W2 part-time role
  • Must be available for 10 hours/week minimum
  • Clinical Administrators must have availability:
    • Monday - Thursday from 3-8pm MT (highly preferred) or
    • Monday - Thursday from 10-2pm MT
    • Friday/Saturday availability highly preferred
  • Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency
  • Have access to reliable technology resources & WiFi to work in a remote setting
  • Previous expertise working with a wide range of ages, including children, teens, young adults, and adults clients in both individual and group settings is highly preferred
  • High attention to detail and ability to work independently and efficiently
  • Proficiency with cloud-based communication and software–Slack, Dropbox, Gmail, Zoom, Google Drive, EMR
  • Limited proficiency in Microsoft Office–Excel, or Google Sheets

Benefits

  • Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

Please note that this role is not available to candidates in Alaska, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Oregon, Washington State, Illinois, or Washington DC.

Additional Information
The expected pay for this role will be $20.00 per hour.

Based on the nature of this role, you will need to complete several state background checks for clearance to see clients. Florida requires a fingerprint based background check, with more information found here. Please note that the cost for this background check will be paid for in full by Charlie Health.

Our Values

  • Connection: Care deeply & inspire hope.
  • Congruence: Stay curious & heed the evidence.
  • Commitment: Act with urgency & don’t give up.

Please do not call our public clinical admissions line in regard to this or any other job posting.

Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud. If you are interested in exploring opportunities at Charlie Health, please go directly to our Careers Page: Charlie Health will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. In addition, Charlie Health will not ask for your personal banking information until you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. All communications with Charlie Health Talent and People Operations professionals will only be sent from @charliehealth.com email addresses. Legitimate emails will never originate from gmail.com, yahoo.com, or other commercial email services.

Recruiting agencies, please do not submit unsolicited referrals for this or any open role. We have a roster of agencies with whom we partner, and we will not pay any fee associated with unsolicited referrals.

At Charlie Health, we value being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to cultivate an environment where individuals can be their authentic selves. Being an Equal Opportunity Employer means every member of our team feels as though they are supported and belong. We value diverse perspectives to help us provide essential mental health and substance use disorder treatments to all young people.

Charlie Health applicants are assessed solely on their qualifications for the role, without regard to disability or need for accommodation.

By clicking "Submit application" below, you agree to Charlie Health's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

By submitting your application, you agree to receive SMS messages from Charlie Health regarding your application. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies. You can reply STOP to opt out at any time. For help, reply HELP.

Our Business
team.blueis an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group; with a team of more than 3000+ experts serving its 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses, offering services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce and server hosting solutions and specialist SaaS providers offering adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position Overview

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will develop and maintain our central data ecosystem, ensuring we extract maximum strategic value from our global data assets. You will be responsible for building, scaling, and governing high-value data products that serve as the "single source of truth" for team.blue and its 60+ subbrands. This role is pivotal in transforming raw data into a sophisticated semantic layer that powers business intelligence, operational efficiency, and cutting-edge AI initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Platform Ownership: Own, manage, continuously optimize our Data Infrastructure including Databricks, Airflow, dbt, Gitlab & AWS. Manage and tune data platforms for peak performance and introduce new capabilities to keep the platform aligned with industry advancements

• Data Product Innovation: Design and deliver high-quality, scalable data products that provide a unified source of truth across a complex ecosystem of 60+ global sub-brands.

• Pipeline Engineering: Build and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest and transform massive volumes of structured and unstructured data, ensuring high availability and low latency for downstream consumers.

• Architectural Leadership: Lead the design of secure, cost-efficient data architectures. Establish and enforce best practices in data modeling, orchestration, and observability.

• Governance & Integrity: Implement rigorous data governance frameworks, including lineage tracking, metadata management, and quality controls to ensure a reliable semantic layer for AI and ML use cases.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a strategic "sparring partner" for Analytics, ML, and AI teams, translating complex business requirements into high-performing technical solutions.

• Platform Optimization: Manage and tune data platforms for peak performance, focusing on indexing strategies, query optimization, and schema evolution.

• Mentorship: Elevate the collective expertise of the engineering team by mentoring junior members and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

YourStrengths:

• Strategic Thinker: You don't just execute; you lead projects from ideation to actionable solution, balancing technical debt with rapid delivery.

• Effective Communicator: You possess the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders.

• Problem Solver: You thrive in fast-paced environments, managing multiple high-priority workstreams with meticulous attention to detail.

Technicalskills required:

• Core Ecosystem: Deep hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog).

• Advanced SQL & Modeling: Expert-level SQL skills (optimization, indexing) and a mastery of data modeling techniques (Dimensional, Star Schema, Snowflake).

• Cloud & Modern Data Stack: Proficiency in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, etc) and modern orchestration tools like Airflow or dbt.

• Database Diversity: Proven experience managing data across various RDBMS platforms (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, etc.).

• DevOps & Engineering: Strong command of Docker/Kubernetes and a commitment to CI/CD best practices.

• Governance: Experience with data versioning, schema evolution, and distributed metadata management.

Educationand work experience:

• Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in data engineering or data management, preferably within a high-growth or multi-brand industry.

• Education: Advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in Computer Science, STEM, or a related quantitative field.

• Track Record: A demonstrable history of deploying stable, high-performance data solutions that drive measurable business value.

At any stage, please be prepared to provide proof of eligibility to work in the
country you’re applying for. Unfortunately, we are unable to support relocation

packages or sponsorship visas

About Us:

WorkHound is a pioneering platform transforming how companies engage with their frontline workforce. By providing a real-time, anonymous feedback app, WorkHound empowers employees to share honest insights about their work experience.

Starting in the trucking industry, where turnover rates are notoriously high, we've made a huge impact and are now expanding into other industries. We're proving to be essential in keeping employees happy and fostering a culture of open communication and ongoing improvement. Our mission? To build better workplaces by boosting employee satisfaction and engagement with insights that lead to real change.


About the Role:

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer on our small and dynamic engineering team, you will play a dual role, supporting both the Product and Engineering teams. You'll not only be hands-on with coding but also responsible for setting up and managing vendors and contract resources to ensure we ship frequently, on time, and with continuous improvements.

You'll collaborate with Product to design and build data structures and system architecture, integrate various systems, and develop both front-end and back-end software applications. Additionally, you'll be involved in QA and performance testing to ensure our products meet the highest standards.

In your first 3 months, you will…

  • Successfully onboard by understanding WorkHound’s architecture, tools, and development workflows.

  • Write and deploy clean, efficient code, delivering a minimum of two small but impactful features end-to-end (front-end and back-end).

  • Design and implement a scalable API integration for a high-priority feature, ensuring proper documentation and testing.

  • Partner closely with Product Management to identify and resolve at least one bottleneck in the development process, implementing an immediate improvement.

Job Title:Sr. Data Engineer

Location:Remote
Type:Full-Time
Experience Level:Senior-Level (8-10 years)

About Us:
CAMP Systems is a global leader in delivering innovative technology solutions that have transformed the Aviation Industry for the past few decades. Building on our legacy of innovation, we've launched our AI Solutions division to pioneer the next generation of intelligent applications.

Our new AI Solutions division combines CAMP Systems' deep industry expertise with cutting-edge artificial intelligence to create transformative products for our customers. We're building a diverse portfolio of AI solutions that address complex industry challenges while setting new standards for innovation in the aviation Industry.

Our team unites self-motivated professionals who thrive on solving difficult problems and pushing technological boundaries. As a member of the core team, you'll have the unique opportunity to shape both our product roadmap and team culture, while working with the latest AI technologies.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have 8-10 years of experience in building production-quality data pipelines utilizing data extraction tools such as Talend, Informatica, and data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake and Redshift. Strong experience with relational databases (such as Oracle), data modeling, and SQL is required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable, high-volume, and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources such as Oracle.

  • Create and optimize data models and schemas to support various use cases (such as AI/ML solutions, benchmarking, customer data delivery) in Snowflake and Redshift.

  • Ensure data quality, integrity/completeness, and governance by implementing best practices for monitoring and validation. Build automated monitoring and alerting mechanisms.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements to support business objectives.

  • Stay up to date with emerging trends and technologies in data engineering.

Required Skills/Qualifications:

  • 8-10 years of experience in building and maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines using tools such as Informatica, Pentaho Data Integration, or other third-party tools.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with relational databases such as Oracle and data modeling.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, SQL, or Scala.

  • 3+ years of experience on data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake and Redshift.

  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance best practices.

  • Keen eye for data accuracy, completeness, and privacy.

  • Familiarity with cloud services such as AWS and Azure.

  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git), JIRA, Confluence.

  • Experience in delivering customer-facing SaaS solutions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to optimize data processing workflows.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and teamwork skills.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience with AI and machine learning applications.

  • Understanding of containerization technologies like Docker.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and innovative projects.

  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

  • Professional development and growth opportunities.
