Are you a strategic, commercially driven leader ready to take full ownership of market expansion in Thailand? This is a rare opportunity to build, scale, and grow a major international brand locally with the autonomy to drive decisions, develop strategies, and shape long-term success in one of the most dynamic economies in Southeast Asia.

About the Role
As Country Manager for Thailand, you will be responsible for the overall commercial success of the Thai market. This includes developing and executing a growth strategy, expanding strategic partnerships, driving revenue, and ensuring strong brand presence in the region. You will act as the key ambassador of the company in Thailand and play a central role in accelerating business performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take full ownership of the commercial development of the Thai market.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through partnerships, affiliates, and direct business channels.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, partners, and key stakeholders.
  • Monitor market trends, competition, and customer needs to develop actionable strategies.
  • Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and engagement across the market.
  • Prepare performance forecasts and deliver on quarterly and annual KPIs.
  • Represent the brand at industry events, conferences, and local business meetings.
  • Cooperate closely with global leadership, compliance, marketing, and product departments.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in business development, partnerships, commercial management, or country management in Thailand.
  • Deep understanding of the Thailand business landscape and local market dynamics.
  • Fluency in Thai and English; strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Self-driven, commercially minded, and confident in decision-making.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to represent the company externally.
  • Results-oriented mindset with experience working towards ambitious growth targets.

Whats Offered

  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.
  • Full ownership and responsibility over the Thailand market.
  • Opportunity to shape market strategy and influence global expansion.
  • Support from a highly experienced international management team.
  • Long-term career path in a fast-growing global organization.

Why Thailand?
Thailand is one of Asias most exciting and fast-developing markets combining economic growth, entrepreneurial energy, and a booming digital business ecosystem. From Bangkoks fast-paced commercial scene to the countrys wider expansion opportunities, this role provides both professional challenge and the opportunity to drive meaningful impact at scale.

If you are a visionary leader with strong commercial instincts and the drive to build success from the ground up, this Country Manager role in Thailand offers the perfect platform to achieve it.

raw.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Life Sciences

➡️ Have a degree or background in Life Sciences and want to apply your knowledge in a more commercial, client-facing role beyond the lab?

➡️ Excited to represent a leading AI-driven platform trusted by global pharma and biotech companies, staying close to cutting-edge science?

➡️ Are you confident, resilient, and motivated to succeed in a high-activity sales role where effort drives pipeline, progression, and earning potential? If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

We have exciting opportunities for Sales Development Representatives to join Patsnap and drive new business growth within our Life Sciences vertical. This role is built for individuals with a Life Sciences background who wants to build a career in high-performance sales — using your curiosity, competitiveness, and communication skills to win new business. If you’re motivated by targets, progression, and uncapped earning potential, and want to develop into a top-performing salesperson, this is your opportunity. As an SDR, you’ll be on the front line of revenue generation — prospecting, engaging, and qualifying new customers across pharma, biotech, and medical devices.

You will:

  • Take a hunter mindset to outbound — owning high-volume outreach across calls, email, and LinkedIn

  • Use your scientific credibility to break into conversations with senior R&D and innovation leaders

  • Create and qualify pipeline, turning cold prospects into real commercial opportunities

  • Handle rejection, stay persistent, and consistently hit and exceed activity and pipeline targets

  • Build the foundations of closing, influencing, and deal progression

  • Partner with Account Executives to convert pipeline into revenue

This is a high-activity, target-driven sales role where success comes down to your drive, resilience, and hunger to win. If you bring the work ethic and mindset, the progression and earning potential are there to match.

This is a remote position based in the Phoenix area. This role supports Account Executives based in Arizona, Texas and/or California and may require periodic in-person collaboration in the Phoenix area.

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, Series E, unicorn SaaS platform that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our user-friendly platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle — using industry-leading, domain-specific AI to generate and validate ideas and bring innovative products to market faster, better, and cheaper. More than 12,000 R&D and IP teams worldwide use and trust PatSnap to innovate and commercialize new products.

As the leading global Life Sciences intelligence platform, Patsnap helps pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and life sciences organizations make better innovation decisions. By connecting patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory data, and market intelligence, we enable our customers to identify white spaces, reduce R&D risk, and accelerate breakthrough innovation. We call this Connected Innovation Intelligence — and we’ll teach you everything you need to know to become an expert.

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in Toronto, London, Shanghai, and Singapore. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Using your incredible communication skills to build brand new relationships between Patsnap and potential clients

  • Working closely with an Account Executive, who will mentor and help to develop your sales skills, while you support their activity by creating sales leads and booking their product demonstrations

  • Owning your territory and choosing which companies to call and will have the autonomy to be creative with how you introduce PatSnap to prospects

  • Learning the necessary tools to be able to succeed in the role; what we ask of you is a can-do attitude and an open mind to learning

  • Researching using varied and creative techniques to identify business opportunities (sales leads)

Requirements

What We'd Love From You:

  • A recent graduate (or early career professional) in Life Sciences or a related field

  • Motivated by earning potential, with a strong drive to succeed in an uncapped commission environment

  • Confident and proactive, comfortable initiating conversations and building relationships with new people

  • Resilient and target-driven, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated in a high-performance sales environment

  • Competitive by nature, with a clear ambition to exceed goals and progress quickly

  • A strong communicator, able to translate complex scientific ideas into clear, compelling value

  • Curious and coachable, eager to learn and continuously improve

  • Highly organized and self-motivated, able to manage your time and pipeline effectively

  • Interested in technology and innovation, and how it drives business and R&D forward

  • A natural problem solver, who enjoys understanding challenges and helping others find solutions

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of a team

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • Unlimited vacation

  • Health and dental benefits for you and your dependents

  • 401K matching

  • Remote work environment + WFH stipend for your home office set-up

  • 24/7 employee assistance program which provides access to virtual healthcare, therapy, financial and legal assistance, wellness counselling and resources for family support.

PatSnap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer (EOE) that champions diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran/military, or disability status, or any other protected status in accordance with federal, provincial/state or local laws.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, we encourage you to apply and tell us why you’d be a great fit for this role! If you require any accommodations during the interview process, please email us at so we can best support you.

Location: Remote | Team: Growth&Marketing | Level: Manager (3-5 yrs)

The Role

HeyMax partners with everyone from yuu to banks, airlines, and hotels — and every partnership comes with marketing firepower behind it. That's where you come in.

You'll be the marketing engine for our Partnerships team. They close the deals and brief you on what's needed; you turn those briefs into campaigns that ship — fast, sharp, and flawless. And when the moment calls for it, you'll sit at the table with partners directly: pitching co-marketing ideas, shaping the campaign, and running it end-to-end from first whiteboard to final send.

This isn't a "pass it to another team" role. You own it — the brief, the copy, the creative direction, the CRM build, the deadline.

What You'll Own

  • Be Partnerships' go-to marketer — take briefs from the internal Partnerships team and turn them into ready-to-ship campaigns, juggling multiple partners and deadlines without breaking a sweat

  • Face partners directly when it counts — join partner discussions, propose co-marketing campaigns, and own them end-to-end from ideation to execution

  • Run a tight ship — timelines, stakeholders, deliverables, follow-ups. Nothing slips, nothing's late, nothing ships with a typo

  • Write the copy that works — EDMs, push, landing pages, co-branded assets. Clear, on-brand, and built to convert

  • Brief creatives like a pro — translate fuzzy asks into briefs so sharp the first draft is nearly the final one

  • Tell the story — connect partner offers to what members actually care about, and build campaign narratives around it

  • Ship CRM comms hands-on — segment, build, QA, deploy. Email, push, in-app, Telegram — you run the full pipeline yourself

You're Probably a Fit If

  • You've spent 3-5 years in B2B or partnerships marketing — loyalty, fintech, travel, or e-commerce a big plus

  • You're the most organized person in any room. Multiple partners, shifting priorities, tight timelines — you thrive there

  • You can hold your own in a room with a bank's brand team in the morning and a merchant's growth team in the afternoon

  • You write well, brief better, and spot the broken link before anyone else does

  • You've shipped CRM campaigns hands-on () — not just planned them

  • You'd rather own something end-to-end than hand it off halfway

  • Startups energize you. Ambiguity doesn't scare you. Speed is your default

Bonus Points

  • You've worked directly with banks, airlines, hotels, or big merchant loyalty programs

  • You know the APAC miles-and-points world (or you're one of us — a points nerd)

  • You've managed agencies or freelance creatives

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

SAP Presales Solutions Engineer (Aerospace & Defense)

Twenty5 | Remote (US) | Full-Time | $100,000 - $130,000 base plus performance-based variable

Due to U.S. government contracting requirements and export control regulations, this position requires U.S. citizenship. Visa sponsorship is not available.

About Twenty5

Twenty5 iPE is a Project CPQ platform native to SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP). We help project-based businesses in Aerospace & Defense, Professional Services, Capital Projects, and Engineer-to-Order manufacturing replace Excel and legacy estimating tools with a single, audit-ready platform that integrates natively with SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA. Our customers include defense primes and large industrial enterprises with rigorous DFARS, DCMA, and TINA compliance requirements. We are about 60 people, remote-first, and growing fast.

The Role

We are hiring our first dedicated presales solutions engineer. You start by owning our SAP BTP demo environment end to end: configuring master data, testing after releases, and keeping it stable and ready to win. You work alongside senior presales on enterprise pursuits, including defense primes and SAP migration deals, then step into your own demos and discovery conversations as your product fluency deepens, typically within 12 to 18 months.

You will:

  • Own and continuously improve our live SAP BTP demo environments
  • Prepare discovery-aligned demo scripts tailored to each account's vertical and pain points
  • Co-present demos for mid-tier accounts and support senior presales on enterprise deals
  • Test new product features first and write clear, reproducible bug tickets for the dev team

What We Are Looking For

One of these backgrounds:

  • Presales solutions engineer at a major enterprise software firm (SAP, Siemens, Oracle, IFS, Hexagon, PTC, or similar)
  • Consultant from a Big 4 or tier-one firm with hands-on SAP implementation experience in industrial or A&D clients
  • Solutions or presales role at a specialized SAP partner or ISV serving A&D, ETO Manufacturing, Capital Projects, or Professional Services

Plus:

  • Hands-on familiarity with SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA; SAP BTP is a strong plus
  • Exceptional communication; you can brief an engineer on a bug and a VP on a business outcome in the same afternoon
  • A&D knowledge is a meaningful differentiator: DCAA, DFARS, CAS compliance, program cost structures, or pricing and estimating workflows
  • Comfort with project-based business models: labor estimating, bill of materials, earned value management

This is not a fit if you have no SAP exposure and no A&D or complex industrial context. The product is too niche to train from zero.

Compensation and Structure
  • $100,000 to $130,000 base plus variable tied to pipeline and demo-to-opportunity conversion
  • Remote-first with 15 to 25 percent travel for workshops and major demos
  • Direct access to the CEO, CPO, and CRO from day one

Twenty5 is an equal opportunity employer.

Recruiting Contact: Muranda Myers

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

​

Benefits

Interview Process
  1. Introductory conversation with the CTO
  2. Technical interview focused on APIs and integration architecture
  3. Practical take-home exercise involving a small API integration, followed by a technical review
  4. Final offer

Description

BDR Solutions, LLC, (BDR) supports the U.S. Federal Government in successfully achieving its mission and goals. Our service and solution delivery starts with understanding each client’s end-state, and then seamlessly integrating within each Agency’s organization to improve and enhance business and technical operations and deployments.

BDR is seeking a Front-End Developer SME to join our growing team! This position will be performed virtually from the individual’s home office working on EST time schedule. This position requires US Citizenship with an active Public Trust.

(Military Veterans and HUBZone candidates are highly encouraged to apply)

Role Overview

The Front-End Developer SME will serve as a technical authority on user interface design and implementation for the modernization initiative. This role will guide the development of intuitive, user-centered web interfaces that comply with government accessibility standards. The SME will provide expert-level input on front-end architecture, reusable component libraries, and best practices for responsive design and accessibility, while mentoring the development team and collaborating closely with UI/UX designers, back-end developers and stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a technical authority on front-end architecture, frameworks, and accessibility compliance for IRS taxpayer-facing applications.
  • Guide the design and development of responsive, accessible, and user-friendly web interfaces using React, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CS3.
  • Ensure compliance with USWDS, ODG, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, performing code reviews for adherence to federal design and accessibility requirements.
  • Collaborate with product owners, designers, and back-end engineers to define technical approaches for delivering scalable, reusable UI components.
  • Provide expertise on front-end performance optimization, API integration, and secure coding best practices.
  • Support CI/CD integration for front-end deployments using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and automated testing tools.
  • Mentor front-end developers by conducing code reviews, sharing best practices, and supporting skills development.
  • Act as a liaison to ensure alignment between design, accessibility, and development teams during the Agile lifecycle.

Required Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Certification Required:
  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust background investigation.
  • Minimum Requirements: Favorable Tier 2 – Moderate Risk Public Trust (SF-85P) investigation.

  • Staff-Like Access: Contractor personnel must receive a favorable suitability determination before being granted staff-like access to IRS information systems.
  • CompTIA Sec+ (or equivalent DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification) (Preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience as a front-end developer, with at least 7+ years in a senior or SME-level role on IT or government projects.
  • Proven experience in Agile/Scrum environments delivering enterprise-scale web applications.
  • Strong experience working with React, JavaScript frameworks, and cloud-hosted applications in
  • AWS/Kubernetes environments.
  • Deep expertise in Reach, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and modern front-end development practices.
  • Strong knowledge of federal design and accessibility standards, including USWDS, ODG, and WCAG 2.2 AA.
  • Advanced skills in building scalable, reusable UI component libraries that meet accessibility and design guidelines.
  • Skilled in front-end performance optimization, automated testing (Jest, Cypress, Selenium), and CI/CD workflows.
  • Ability to architect front-end solutions and advise on technical decision-making for enterprise applications.
  • Ability to mentor developers and lead code reviews, ensuring compliance with accessibility and security requirements.

Preferred:

  • Certified Secure Software Library Professional (CSSLP) or equivalent security-focused credential (Preferred).
  • AAP Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC) or Web Accessibility Specialist (WAS) (Preferred).

The salary compensation range for this position is $140,000 – $165,000. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

JOB OVERVIEW

Date

Job Title

Web Content Manager

Department

Communications & Marketing

Location

Remote, USA

Reports to

Director Communications & Marketing

Salary Range

The annual salary range is between $75,000-$85,000, depending on level of experience. Benefits include health insurance, a monthly data/business expense stipend, employer contributions towards a retirement plan, four weeks of paid vacation, eight sick days, and 11 paid holidays.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

The Steve Fund is dedicated to the mental health and emotional well-being of young people of color. We work with colleges and universities, nonprofit organizations, mental health experts, families, and communities to implement strategies that build knowledge, skills, and resources to help young people of color thrive.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Steve Fund is seeking an experienced and creative Web Content Manager to lead our website strategy and digital content initiatives. This role will manage, develop, and optimize website content to increase engagement, improve accessibility, and strengthen the organization's digital presence. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of web management, SEO best practices, and an eye for design. This role requires collaboration with internal teams, including marketing, programs, and leadership, to ensure the website aligns with our mission and meets the needs of our audience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Content Strategy & Development: Lead content creation, editing, and management for The Steve Fund website to ensure consistency, accuracy, and alignment with our messaging and goals.
  • Web Maintenance & Optimization: Manage ongoing updates to web pages, troubleshoot any website issues, and regularly monitor site performance.
  • SEO & Analytics: Implement SEO strategies to enhance search rankings, increase organic traffic, and improve user experience. Monitor site analytics and generate monthly reports to track progress and optimize content.
  • Design & User Experience (UX): Collaborate with designers to enhance site visuals and user interface. Ensure the site is intuitive, accessible, and engaging for diverse audiences.
  • Content Calendar & Workflow: Develop and maintain a content calendar to support campaign launches, program updates, and marketing initiatives.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the Director of Communication and Marketing, along with other departments, to ensure website content aligns with organizational priorities and reflects current programming and partnerships.
  • Compliance & Accessibility: Ensure the website adheres to web accessibility standards (WCAG) and data protection regulations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in communications, digital marketing, web design, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience managing websites and digital content for a mission-driven organization or similar.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in content management systems (e.g., WordPress), HTML, CSS, and familiarity with web design principles. Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, and accessibility standards is essential.
  • Design Aptitude: Strong visual sense and understanding of UX/UI design principles. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite or Canva is a plus.
  • Project Management: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences.
  • Mission Alignment: Passion for The Steve Fund's mission and a commitment to advancing mental health support for young people of color.

SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Highly organized and capable of developing and delivering on business relevant timelines.
  • Strong growth mindset.
  • Demonstrated success in managing a multipronged, collaborative communications program against an urgent strategy plan.
  • Understands and embraces the urgency of this organization’s mission and deliverables.
  • Commitment to and ability to produce excellence
  • Highly self-motivated.

· Highly collaborative and adept at a one team approach and partnerships.

WHY JOIN THE STEVE FUND?

The Steve Fund is at the forefront of advancing mental health initiatives for young people of color. Join a dedicated team of professionals committed to making a difference. This role offers the opportunity to shape the digital face of an impactful organization and contribute to innovative approaches to mental health support.

LEGAL NOTICE

The Steve Fund is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, citizenship status, and genetic

information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Salary Pay Range
$75,000—$85,000 USD

Job Description

Would you like to own a meaningful financial services practice under the Allstate brand?
Scale your existing practice with proven support, flexibility and access to new customers. We’re looking for
professionals with a growing practice who would like to use the Allstate brand and resources to expand, in your
community.
Your Practice.
As an Allstate Financial Specialist, you’ll build your own financial services practice with support from Allstate. Your
partnership with Allstate Agency owners will drive new business in your community and support your access to
new revenue streams
Your Support Team.
We support our Financial Specialists across the nation with a variety of product offerings and continued education
that helps them succeed. Financial specialists can share space with an Allstate agency owner and obtain leads from
them.
Your Rewards.
We believe hard work should be rewarded. At Allstate, we offer unlimited earning potential that’s always
connected to the growth of your business.
Your Work.
A typical agency office has one financial specialist who meets with customers face-to-face and a team of licensed
professionals who enhances the team's ability to build deep relationships with customers and provide leads.
Allstate provides support and expertise to help you build your business.

Are You a Fit? We are looking for someone who possesses an unquenched entrepreneurial spirit and a strong track record of success. You’ll also need to have: • At least 2 years of life insurance or financial services customer facing sales experience • State Life/Health Insurance Licenses • FINRA Series 6 or 7 and 63 (if applicable) licenses • Blended mix of protection and asset accumulation sales • Prior Experience as a Financial Advisor, Financial Planner, Registered Representative or Investment Representative preferred • Professional designations such as RICP, FSCP, CLU, ChFC, CFP and LUTCF preferred • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) with emphasis on business preferred

Subject to all terms and conditions outlined in the Allstate Personal Financial Representative (PFR) agreements. If selected to be an Allstate PFR, bring your financial experience and proven track record to Allstate. Allstate PFRs are not franchisees. They are independent contractors and are not employed by Allstate Insurance Company (“Allstate”) or its affiliates. Securities offered through Allstate Financial Services, LLC (LSA Securities in LA and PA). Registered Broker-Dealer. Member FINRA, SIPC. Main Office: 2920 South 84th Street, Lincoln, NE 68506. (877) 525-5727. Allstate is an Equal Opportunity Company. Note: Life and Health, and FINRA Series 6 & 63 (if applicable) licenses are required. To sell investment advisory services, Series 65 or 7 & 66 licenses would also be required. ©2018 Allstate Insurance Company, Northbrook, IL.

At Allstate, we work hard to help people live a good life every day. Allstaters are dedicated to serving clients, customers, and communities, which allows employees to find meaning and value in their work. Allstate helps protect nearly 16 million households with auto, home, life, and retirement products. We want every professional connected to Allstate to be committed to giving our customers the best and that means finding the best talent. We want you to be our next great addition.
